manifests.yaml:
schema_version: "2.0.0"
name: "api-contract"
version: "1.0.2"
description: "OpenAPI/Swagger spec vs client code drift detector — parses spec, walks fetch/axios calls, detects mismatches"
initial_state: "DISCOVER_APIS"

middleware:
  hooks:
    - name: telemetry
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        emitter: stdout
    - name: audit
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        destination: ".reactive/api-contract.audit.log"
        redact: []
    - name: invariant_checker
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        rules_file: "runtime/hooks/invariants.yaml"
        on_violation: halt
    - name: context_sanitizer
      trigger: pre_transition
      config:
        patterns:
          - ".*_TOKEN"
          - ".*_KEY"
          - "password"
          - "api_key"
        replacement: "[REDACTED]"

context_keys:
  - "api_spec_path"
  - "client_code_paths"
  - "spec_schema"
  - "client_endpoints"
  - "drift_findings"
  - "missing_endpoints"
  - "type_mismatches"
  - "deprecated_usage"
  - "coverage_matrix"
  - "revision_feedback"

default_context:
  api_spec_path: null
  client_code_paths: []
  spec_schema: null
  client_endpoints: []
  drift_findings: []
  missing_endpoints: []
  type_mismatches: []
  deprecated_usage: []
  coverage_matrix: {}
  revision_feedback: null

states:
  DISCOVER_APIS:
    description: "Discover OpenAPI/Swagger spec and identify client code paths"
    prompt_template: "states/discover_apis.md"
    tools: ["view_file", "grep_search", "find_by_name"]
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "DISCOVERY_STARTED"
    transitions:
      SPEC_LOADED:
        target: "VALIDATION_PIPELINE"
        guard: "Boolean(event.payload.api_spec_path) && Boolean(event.payload.client_code_paths)"

  VALIDATION_PIPELINE:
    description: "Composite state: spec validation, client code walking, and drift diffing"
    initial_substate: "SCHEMA_VALIDATION"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "VALIDATION_STARTED"
    transitions:
      SECURITY_CRITICAL_FOUND:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.severity === 'critical'"
    substates:
      SCHEMA_VALIDATION:
        description: "Composite state: parse and validate OpenAPI spec schema"
        initial_substate: "OPENAPI_CHECK"
        on_enter:
          - emit_signal: "SCHEMA_VALIDATION_STARTED"
        substates:
          OPENAPI_CHECK:
            description: "Validate spec is well-formed OpenAPI/Swagger"
            prompt_template: "states/validation_pipeline/schema_validation/openapi_check.md"
            tools: ["view_file", "grep_search"]
            transitions:
              OPENAPI_CHECK_DONE:
                target: "VALIDATION_PIPELINE.SCHEMA_VALIDATION.TYPE_COMPATIBILITY"
                guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
              OPENAPI_CHECK_FAILED:
                target: "ERROR"

          TYPE_COMPATIBILITY:
            description: "Verify spec schema types and definitions are consistent"
            prompt_template: "states/validation_pipeline/schema_validation/type_compatibility.md"
            tools: ["view_file", "grep_search"]
            transitions:
              TYPE_CHECK_DONE:
                target: "VALIDATION_PIPELINE.SCHEMA_VALIDATION.BREAKING_CHANGE_DETECTION"
                guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
              TYPE_MISMATCH_FOUND:
                target: "ERROR"

          BREAKING_CHANGE_DETECTION:
            description: "Scan for deprecated endpoints and breaking change patterns"
            prompt_template: "states/validation_pipeline/schema_validation/breaking_change_detection.md"
            tools: ["view_file", "grep_search"]
            transitions:
              BREAKING_CHECK_DONE:
                target: "VALIDATION_PIPELINE.SCHEMA_VALIDATION.EXAMPLE_CONFORMANCE"
                guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"

          EXAMPLE_CONFORMANCE:
            description: "Validate spec examples match schema definitions"
            prompt_template: "states/validation_pipeline/schema_validation/example_conformance.md"
            tools: ["view_file", "grep_search"]
            transitions:
              EXAMPLE_CHECK_DONE:
                target: "VALIDATION_PIPELINE.DRIFT_DIFFING"
                guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
              EXAMPLE_MISMATCH_FOUND:
                target: "ERROR"

      DRIFT_DIFFING:
        description: "Walk client code and diff against spec for mismatches"
        prompt_template: "states/validation_pipeline/drift_diffing.md"
        tools: ["view_file", "grep_search"]
        transitions:
          DRIFT_DIFFED:
            target: "DRIFT_ANALYSIS"
            guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"

  DRIFT_ANALYSIS:
    description: "Analyze drift findings and classify by severity"
    prompt_template: "states/drift_analysis.md"
    tools: ["view_file", "grep_search"]
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "ANALYSIS_STARTED"
    transitions:
      DRIFT_CLASSIFIED:
        target: "REPORT"
      CRITICAL_DRIFT:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.severity === 'critical'"

  REPORT:
    description: "Composite state: generate drift report and fix recommendations"
    initial_substate: "VIOLATION_SUMMARY"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "REPORT_STARTED"
    transitions:
      REPORT_ERROR:
        target: "ERROR"
    substates:
      VIOLATION_SUMMARY:
        description: "Summarize all drift violations by category"
        prompt_template: "states/report/violation_summary.md"
        tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file"]
        transitions:
          SUMMARY_GENERATED:
            target: "REPORT.FIX_RECOMMENDATIONS"

      FIX_RECOMMENDATIONS:
        description: "Generate actionable fix recommendations for each violation"
        prompt_template: "states/report/fix_recommendations.md"
        tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file"]
        transitions:
          RECOMMENDATIONS_GENERATED:
            target: "GATE"

  GATE:
    description: "Human review gate: approve, request revisions, or reject"
    prompt_template: "states/gate.md"
    human_gate:
      type: "choice"
      tool: "ask_question"
      options:
        - "Approve & Complete"
        - "Request Revisions (back to DRIFT_ANALYSIS)"
        - "Reject (Block)"
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: "COMPLETED"
        guard: "event.payload.approved === true"
      USER_REQUEST_REVISIONS:
        target: "DRIFT_ANALYSIS"
        guard: "event.payload.revisions_requested === true"
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.rejected === true"

  COMPLETED:
    description: "Terminal state: API contract validation complete"
    prompt_template: "states/completed.md"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "DELIVERABLE_READY"

  BLOCKED:
    description: "Terminal state: Critical issues found, workflow halted"
    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "PR_REVIEW_BLOCKED"

  ERROR:
    description: "Terminal state: Unrecoverable error occurred"
    prompt_template: "states/error.md"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "SKILL_ERROR"

deliverable_projections:
  - template: "templates/drift_report.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/api-contract/drift.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION", "SIGNAL_EMITTED"]
  - template: "templates/coverage_matrix.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/api-contract/coverage.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]
  - template: "templates/state_snapshot.json.hbs"
    output: ".docs/api-contract/state.json"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]

schema_version: "2.0.0"
name: "browser-verifier"
version: "1.0.2"
description: "Automated browser verification reactive skill that launches headless browser sessions, verifies DOM states, intercepts console errors, and captures visual artifacts."
initial_state: "INTAKE"

middleware:
  hooks:
    - name: telemetry
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        emitter: stdout
    - name: audit
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        destination: ".reactive/browser-verifier.audit.log"
        redact: []
    - name: context_sanitizer
      trigger: pre_transition
      config:
        patterns:
          - ".*_TOKEN"
          - ".*_KEY"
          - ".*_SECRET"
          - "password"
        replacement: "[REDACTED]"

context_keys:
  - "target_url"
  - "test_suite"
  - "browser_type"
  - "assertion_rules"
  - "console_errors"
  - "network_failures"
  - "screenshot_path"
  - "gate_decision"
  - "deliverable_path"

default_context:
  target_url: "http://localhost:3000"
  test_suite: null
  browser_type: "chromium"
  assertion_rules: []
  console_errors: []
  network_failures: []
  screenshot_path: null
  gate_decision: null
  deliverable_path: ".docs/browser-verifier/"

states:
  INTAKE:
    description: "Collect target application URL, browser configuration, and DOM assertion rules"
    prompt_template: "states/intake.md"
    transitions:
      CONFIGURE:
        target: "BOOT"
        guard: "Boolean(context.target_url) && Array.isArray(context.assertion_rules) && context.assertion_rules.length > 0"
      ABORT:
        target: "ERROR"

  BOOT:
    description: "Initialize headless browser instance and configure diagnostic listeners"
    prompt_template: "states/boot.md"
    transitions:
      READY:
        target: "NAVIGATE"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  NAVIGATE:
    description: "Navigate to target URL, verify HTTP response code, and await network idle"
    prompt_template: "states/navigate.md"
    transitions:
      LOADED:
        target: "ASSERT_DOM"
      NETWORK_FAIL:
        target: "BLOCKED"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  ASSERT_DOM:
    description: "Execute structural DOM assertions, visibility checks, and interactive element verification"
    prompt_template: "states/assert_dom.md"
    transitions:
      VERIFIED:
        target: "INSPECT_CONSOLE"
      ASSERTION_FAIL:
        target: "BLOCKED"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  INSPECT_CONSOLE:
    description: "Inspect browser execution logs for unhandled errors, warnings, and failed network calls"
    prompt_template: "states/inspect_console.md"
    transitions:
      CLEAN:
        target: "CAPTURE_ARTIFACT"
      ERRORS_FOUND:
        target: "BLOCKED"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  CAPTURE_ARTIFACT:
    description: "Capture visual screenshot and DOM state snapshot into documentation deliverables"
    prompt_template: "states/capture_artifact.md"
    transitions:
      CAPTURED:
        target: "GATE"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  GATE:
    description: "Evaluate complete browser verification results and issue release pass or block decision"
    prompt_template: "states/gate.md"
    transitions:
      APPROVE:
        target: "SUCCESS"
        guard: "context.console_errors.length === 0"
      REJECT:
        target: "BLOCKED"

  SUCCESS:
    description: "Browser verification passed cleanly with zero errors and all assertions verified"
    prompt_template: "states/success.md"

  BLOCKED:
    description: "Verification blocked due to failed assertions, console exceptions, or network errors"
    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"

  ERROR:
    description: "Fatal error during browser lifecycle or unrecoverable test runner fault"
    prompt_template: "states/error.md"

schema_version: 2.1.0
name: build-advisor
version: 1.0.3
type: reactive
description: >-
  Develop worthwhile products, challenge existing ideas and experiences, or advise builders on product, leadership,
  team, business, and career decisions using contextual principles from Tony Fadell's Build.
initial_state: INIT
strict_execution: true
runtime_requirements:
  min_runtime_version: 0.16.0
  required_capabilities:
    - runtime.bootloader
    - runtime.transport_handshake
context_keys:
  - selected_runtime
  - basis_version
  - route
  - situation
  - evidence
  - problem
  - story
  - experience
  - learning_plan
  - assessment
  - uncertainty_plan
  - diagnosis
  - options
  - recommendation
  - decision
  - action
default_context:
  basis_version: 1
  route: null
  situation: null
  evidence: []
  problem: null
  story: null
  experience: null
  learning_plan: null
  assessment: null
  uncertainty_plan: null
  diagnosis: null
  options: null
  recommendation: null
  decision: null
  action: null
states:
  INIT:
    description: Select a compatible runtime
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    model:
      tier: fast
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: ACTIVE
        guard: >-
          payload.compatible === true && payload.contextUpdates?.selected_runtime?.compatible === true &&
          payload.contextUpdates.selected_runtime.parent_dispatch_verified === true
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: BYPASS_DETECTED
        guard: payload.compatible === false
  ACTIVE:
    description: Shared situation and evidence; global changes bubble from any route
    prompt_template: states/active/parent.md
    initial_substate: FRAME
    transitions:
      ROUTE_CHANGED:
        target: ACTIVE.FRAME
        guard: >-
          ["develop","challenge","advise"].includes(payload.contextUpdates?.route) && typeof payload.reason === "string"
          && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
      SITUATION_CHANGED:
        target: ACTIVE.FRAME
        guard: >-
          Number.isInteger(payload.contextUpdates?.basis_version) && payload.contextUpdates.basis_version ===
          context.basis_version + 1 && typeof payload.reason === "string" && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
      CANCEL:
        target: CANCELLED
        guard: typeof payload.reason === "string" && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
    substates:
      FRAME:
        description: Capture the decision question, stage, constraints, evidence, and requested route
        prompt_template: states/active/frame.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          DEVELOP_SELECTED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP
            guard: >-
              payload.contextUpdates?.route === "develop" && payload.contextUpdates?.situation != null && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.question === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.question.trim().length > 0 &&
              ["product","leadership","business","team","career"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.situation.domain) &&
              typeof payload.contextUpdates.situation.stage === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.stage.trim().length > 0 && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.decision_owner === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.decision_owner.trim().length > 0 &&
              Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.situation.constraints) &&
              Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.evidence) && payload.contextUpdates.evidence.every(e => e && typeof
              e.id === "string" && e.id.trim().length > 0 && typeof e.claim === "string" && e.claim.trim().length > 0 &&
              ["observed","interpretation","assumption","conviction"].includes(e.kind) && typeof e.source === "string"
              && e.source.trim().length > 0)
          CHALLENGE_SELECTED:
            target: ACTIVE.CHALLENGE
            guard: >-
              payload.contextUpdates?.route === "challenge" && payload.contextUpdates?.situation != null && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.question === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.question.trim().length > 0 &&
              ["product","leadership","business","team","career"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.situation.domain) &&
              typeof payload.contextUpdates.situation.stage === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.stage.trim().length > 0 && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.decision_owner === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.decision_owner.trim().length > 0 &&
              Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.situation.constraints) &&
              Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.evidence) && payload.contextUpdates.evidence.every(e => e && typeof
              e.id === "string" && e.id.trim().length > 0 && typeof e.claim === "string" && e.claim.trim().length > 0 &&
              ["observed","interpretation","assumption","conviction"].includes(e.kind) && typeof e.source === "string"
              && e.source.trim().length > 0)
          ADVISE_SELECTED:
            target: ACTIVE.ADVISE
            guard: >-
              payload.contextUpdates?.route === "advise" && payload.contextUpdates?.situation != null && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.question === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.question.trim().length > 0 &&
              ["product","leadership","business","team","career"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.situation.domain) &&
              typeof payload.contextUpdates.situation.stage === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.stage.trim().length > 0 && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.decision_owner === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.situation.decision_owner.trim().length > 0 &&
              Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.situation.constraints) &&
              Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.evidence) && payload.contextUpdates.evidence.every(e => e && typeof
              e.id === "string" && e.id.trim().length > 0 && typeof e.claim === "string" && e.claim.trim().length > 0 &&
              ["observed","interpretation","assumption","conviction"].includes(e.kind) && typeof e.source === "string"
              && e.source.trim().length > 0)
        on_enter:
          - set_context:
              recommendation: null
              decision: null
              action: null
        context_scope:
          - selected_runtime
          - basis_version
          - route
          - situation
          - evidence
          - problem
          - story
          - experience
          - assessment
          - diagnosis
      DEVELOP:
        description: Make a worthwhile direction and prototype the whole customer experience
        prompt_template: states/active/develop/parent.md
        initial_substate: PROBLEM
        transitions:
          REVISE_PROBLEM:
            target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP.PROBLEM
            guard: typeof payload.reason === "string" && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
        substates:
          PROBLEM:
            description: Frame recurring customer pain and existing alternatives
            prompt_template: states/active/develop/problem.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              PROBLEM_FRAMED:
                target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP.STORY
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.problem?.basis_version === context.basis_version && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.problem.customer === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.problem.customer.trim().length > 0 && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.problem.pain === "string" && payload.contextUpdates.problem.pain.trim().length
                  > 0 && typeof payload.contextUpdates.problem.why_now === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.problem.why_now.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.problem.alternatives) &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.problem.alternatives.length > 0
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - problem
          STORY:
            description: Explain why the product should exist and what it promises
            prompt_template: states/active/develop/story.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              STORY_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP.EXPERIENCE
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.story?.basis_version === context.basis_version && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.story.narrative === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.story.narrative.trim().length > 0 && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.story.promise === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.story.promise.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.story.claims)
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - problem
              - story
          EXPERIENCE:
            description: Map and prototype every applicable journey stage
            prompt_template: states/active/develop/experience.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              EXPERIENCE_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP.LEARNING
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.experience?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.experience.touchpoints) &&
                  ["discovery","evaluation","acquisition","onboarding","use","support","retention","exit"].every(stage
                  => payload.contextUpdates.experience.touchpoints.some(t => t?.stage === stage &&
                  ["mapped","needs_test","not_applicable"].includes(t.status) && typeof t.detail === "string" &&
                  t.detail.trim().length > 0))
              REVISE_STORY:
                target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP.STORY
                guard: typeof payload.reason === "string" && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - problem
              - story
              - experience
          LEARNING:
            description: Define constraints, experiments, launch readiness, and later learning
            prompt_template: states/active/develop/learning.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              DEVELOPMENT_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.DECISION
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.learning_plan?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.experiments) &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.milestones) &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.milestones.length > 0 && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.launch_criteria === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.launch_criteria.trim().length > 0 && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.next_generation === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.learning_plan.next_generation.trim().length > 0 &&
                  payload.contextUpdates?.recommendation?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.route === context.route &&
                  ["proceed","revise","investigate","defer","stop"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.direction)
                  && typeof payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.rationale === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.rationale.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.limitations)
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - problem
              - story
              - experience
              - learning_plan
      CHALLENGE:
        description: Stress-test an existing proposal without inventing defects
        prompt_template: states/active/challenge/parent.md
        initial_substate: INSPECT
        transitions:
          REVISE_REVIEW:
            target: ACTIVE.CHALLENGE.INSPECT
            guard: typeof payload.reason === "string" && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
        substates:
          INSPECT:
            description: Inspect the actual proposal or experience and its promises
            prompt_template: states/active/challenge/inspect.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              REVIEW_SCOPED:
                target: ACTIVE.CHALLENGE.STRESS_TEST
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.assessment?.basis_version === context.basis_version && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.assessment.artifact === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.assessment.artifact.trim().length > 0 && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.assessment.summary === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.assessment.summary.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.assessment.findings)
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - problem
              - story
              - experience
              - assessment
          STRESS_TEST:
            description: Design bounded tests for consequential unknowns
            prompt_template: states/active/challenge/stress_test.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              TESTS_DEFINED:
                target: ACTIVE.CHALLENGE.VERDICT
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.uncertainty_plan?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.uncertainty_plan.tests) &&
                  (payload.contextUpdates.uncertainty_plan.tests.length > 0 || (typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.uncertainty_plan.no_test_reason === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.uncertainty_plan.no_test_reason.trim().length > 0)) &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.uncertainty_plan.tests.every(t => t && typeof t.question === "string" &&
                  t.question.trim().length > 0 && typeof t.method === "string" && t.method.trim().length > 0 && typeof
                  t.measure === "string" && t.measure.trim().length > 0 && typeof t.deadline === "string" &&
                  t.deadline.trim().length > 0 && ["planned","observed"].includes(t.status) &&
                  Array.isArray(t.evidence_refs) && (t.status === "planned" || (t.evidence_refs.length > 0 &&
                  t.evidence_refs.every(id => context.evidence.some(e => e.id === id && e.kind === "observed")))))
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - assessment
              - uncertainty_plan
          VERDICT:
            description: Recommend pursue, revise, investigate, defer, or stop with uncertainty
            prompt_template: states/active/challenge/verdict.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              VERDICT_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.DECISION
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.recommendation?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.route === context.route &&
                  ["proceed","revise","investigate","defer","stop"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.direction)
                  && typeof payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.rationale === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.rationale.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.limitations)
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - assessment
              - uncertainty_plan
      ADVISE:
        description: Diagnose a concrete builder decision and compare tradeoffs
        prompt_template: states/active/advise/parent.md
        initial_substate: DIAGNOSE
        transitions:
          REVISE_DIAGNOSIS:
            target: ACTIVE.ADVISE.DIAGNOSE
            guard: typeof payload.reason === "string" && payload.reason.trim().length > 0
        substates:
          DIAGNOSE:
            description: Identify the underlying builder decision and relevant principles
            prompt_template: states/active/advise/diagnose.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              DIAGNOSIS_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.ADVISE.OPTIONS
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.diagnosis?.basis_version === context.basis_version && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.diagnosis.issue === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.diagnosis.issue.trim().length > 0 && typeof
                  payload.contextUpdates.diagnosis.decision_type === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.diagnosis.decision_type.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.diagnosis.principles) &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.diagnosis.principles.length > 0
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - diagnosis
          OPTIONS:
            description: Compare feasible options and their consequences
            prompt_template: states/active/advise/options.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              OPTIONS_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.ADVISE.RECOMMEND
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.options?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.options.choices) && payload.contextUpdates.options.choices.length
                  >= 2 && payload.contextUpdates.options.choices.every(o => o && typeof o.choice === "string" &&
                  o.choice.trim().length > 0 && typeof o.consequences === "string" && o.consequences.trim().length > 0)
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - diagnosis
              - options
          RECOMMEND:
            description: Recommend a direction, responsible owner, and communication
            prompt_template: states/active/advise/recommend.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              ADVICE_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.DECISION
                guard: >-
                  payload.contextUpdates?.recommendation?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.route === context.route &&
                  ["proceed","revise","investigate","defer","stop"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.direction)
                  && typeof payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.rationale === "string" &&
                  payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.rationale.trim().length > 0 &&
                  Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.recommendation.limitations)
            context_scope:
              - selected_runtime
              - basis_version
              - route
              - situation
              - evidence
              - diagnosis
              - options
      DECISION:
        description: Present the recommendation and obtain an explicit human decision
        prompt_template: states/active/decision.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          DECISION_ACCEPTED:
            target: ACTIVE.NEXT_ACTION
            guard: >-
              payload.approved === true && typeof payload.approval_source === "string" &&
              payload.approval_source.trim().length > 0 && payload.contextUpdates?.decision?.basis_version ===
              context.basis_version && context.recommendation?.basis_version === context.basis_version &&
              context.recommendation?.route === context.route &&
              ["proceed","revise","investigate","defer","stop"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.decision.direction) &&
              typeof payload.contextUpdates.decision.rationale === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.decision.rationale.trim().length > 0 && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.decision.owner === "string" && payload.contextUpdates.decision.owner.trim().length
              > 0
          DECISION_REVISED:
            target: ACTIVE.FRAME
            guard: typeof payload.feedback === "string" && payload.feedback.trim().length > 0
        human_gate:
          type: approval
          tool: chat
          prompt: Review the recommendation, uncertainty, and alternatives; choose or revise the direction.
          auto_stop: true
        context_scope:
          - selected_runtime
          - basis_version
          - route
          - situation
          - evidence
          - recommendation
          - options
          - assessment
          - uncertainty_plan
      NEXT_ACTION:
        description: Assign the next action and define when to revisit the decision
        prompt_template: states/active/next_action.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          ACTION_PLANNED:
            target: ACTIVE.AWAIT_EVIDENCE
            guard: >-
              payload.contextUpdates?.action?.basis_version === context.basis_version && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.action.owner === "string" && payload.contextUpdates.action.owner.trim().length > 0
              && typeof payload.contextUpdates.action.next_step === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.action.next_step.trim().length > 0 && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.action.review_trigger === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.action.review_trigger.trim().length > 0 && context.decision?.basis_version ===
              context.basis_version && ["experiment","review"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.action.type)
          HANDOFF_READY:
            target: COMPLETED
            guard: >-
              payload.contextUpdates?.action?.basis_version === context.basis_version && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.action.owner === "string" && payload.contextUpdates.action.owner.trim().length > 0
              && typeof payload.contextUpdates.action.next_step === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.action.next_step.trim().length > 0 && typeof
              payload.contextUpdates.action.review_trigger === "string" &&
              payload.contextUpdates.action.review_trigger.trim().length > 0 && context.decision?.basis_version ===
              context.basis_version && ["handoff","stop"].includes(payload.contextUpdates.action.type) &&
              payload.handoff_delivered === true
        context_scope:
          - selected_runtime
          - basis_version
          - route
          - situation
          - evidence
          - recommendation
          - decision
          - action
      AWAIT_EVIDENCE:
        description: Wait for actual external results without manufacturing progress
        prompt_template: states/active/await_evidence.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          RESULTS_RECEIVED:
            target: ACTIVE.FRAME
            guard: >-
              Number.isInteger(payload.contextUpdates?.basis_version) && payload.contextUpdates.basis_version ===
              context.basis_version + 1 && Array.isArray(payload.contextUpdates.evidence) &&
              Array.isArray(payload.result_refs) && payload.result_refs.length > 0 && payload.result_refs.every(id =>
              payload.contextUpdates.evidence.some(e => e?.id === id && e.kind === "observed" && typeof e.claim ===
              "string" && e.claim.trim().length > 0 && typeof e.source === "string" && e.source.trim().length > 0) &&
              !context.evidence.some(e => e.id === id))
        human_gate:
          type: text
          tool: chat
          prompt: Return with observed results and their sources, or request a route change or handoff.
          auto_stop: true
        context_scope:
          - selected_runtime
          - basis_version
          - route
          - situation
          - evidence
          - decision
          - action
  COMPLETED:
    description: Decision and handoff delivered
    prompt_template: states/completed.md
    model:
      tier: fast
    transitions: {}
  CANCELLED:
    description: User cancelled this advisory run
    prompt_template: states/cancelled.md
    model:
      tier: fast
    transitions: {}
  BYPASS_DETECTED:
    description: Stop and recover when runtime compatibility or signal contract fails
    prompt_template: states/bypass_detected.md
    model:
      tier: fast
    transitions: {}
deliverable_projections:
  - template: templates/decision.md.hbs
    output: .docs/build-advisor/{{jobId}}/decision.md
    trigger_on:
      - DECISION_ACCEPTED
      - ACTION_PLANNED
      - HANDOFF_READY
  - template: templates/snapshot.json.hbs
    output: .docs/build-advisor/{{jobId}}/snapshot.json
    trigger_on:
      - STATE_TRANSITION

schema_version: "2.0.0"
name: "ci-cd-automation"
version: "1.0.1"
description: "Automated CI/CD pipeline generator and linter that scaffolds production-ready workflows with caching, matrix builds, and security gates."
initial_state: "INTAKE"

middleware:
  hooks:
    - name: telemetry
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        emitter: stdout
    - name: audit
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        destination: ".reactive/ci-cd-automation.audit.log"
        redact: []
    - name: context_sanitizer
      trigger: pre_transition
      config:
        patterns:
          - ".*_TOKEN"
          - ".*_KEY"
          - ".*_SECRET"
          - "password"
        replacement: "[REDACTED]"

context_keys:
  - "provider"
  - "ecosystem"
  - "test_command"
  - "build_command"
  - "workflow_path"
  - "lint_errors"
  - "security_findings"
  - "gate_decision"
  - "deliverable_path"

default_context:
  provider: "github-actions"
  ecosystem: null
  test_command: null
  build_command: null
  workflow_path: null
  lint_errors: []
  security_findings: []
  gate_decision: null
  deliverable_path: ".docs/ci-cd-automation/"

states:
  INTAKE:
    description: "Collect target CI provider, project build commands, and testing requirements"
    prompt_template: "states/intake.md"
    transitions:
      CONFIGURE:
        target: "DETECT_STACK"
        guard: "Boolean(context.provider)"
      ABORT:
        target: "ERROR"

  DETECT_STACK:
    description: "Detect repository language, package manager, and caching strategy"
    prompt_template: "states/detect_stack.md"
    transitions:
      DETECTED:
        target: "GENERATE_PIPELINE"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  GENERATE_PIPELINE:
    description: "Scaffold workflow configuration with matrix testing, caching, and least-privilege permissions"
    prompt_template: "states/generate_pipeline.md"
    transitions:
      GENERATED:
        target: "LINT_WORKFLOW"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  LINT_WORKFLOW:
    description: "Verify workflow YAML syntax, step references, and action version integrity"
    prompt_template: "states/lint_workflow.md"
    transitions:
      VALID:
        target: "SECURITY_AUDIT"
      SYNTAX_ERROR:
        target: "BLOCKED"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  SECURITY_AUDIT:
    description: "Audit pipeline for permission boundaries, secret exfiltration risks, and action pinning"
    prompt_template: "states/security_audit.md"
    transitions:
      SECURE:
        target: "GATE"
      VULNERABILITY_FOUND:
        target: "BLOCKED"
      FAIL:
        target: "ERROR"

  GATE:
    description: "Evaluate workflow compliance and issue final approval for deployment"
    prompt_template: "states/gate.md"
    transitions:
      APPROVE:
        target: "SUCCESS"
        guard: "context.security_findings.length === 0"
      REJECT:
        target: "BLOCKED"

  SUCCESS:
    description: "CI/CD pipeline generated, verified, and hardened successfully"
    prompt_template: "states/success.md"

  BLOCKED:
    description: "Pipeline blocked due to security violations, invalid syntax, or failed quality checks"
    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"

  ERROR:
    description: "Fatal error during stack detection or workflow generation"
    prompt_template: "states/error.md"

schema_version: "2.0.0"
name: "docs-architect"
version: "1.0.3"
description: "Documentation architecture workflow that discovers source truth, designs information architecture, authors living documentation, embeds diagrams, validates links, and gates publication."
initial_state: "INTAKE"

middleware:
  hooks:
    - name: telemetry
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        emitter: stdout
    - name: audit
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        destination: ".reactive/docs-architect.audit.log"
        redact: []
    - name: invariant_checker
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        rules_file: "runtime/hooks/invariants.yaml"
        on_violation: halt
    - name: context_sanitizer
      trigger: pre_transition
      config:
        patterns:
          - ".*_TOKEN"
          - ".*_KEY"
          - ".*_SECRET"
          - "password"
          - "api_key"
        replacement: "[REDACTED]"

context_keys:
  - "source_paths"
  - "audience"
  - "outcomes"
  - "documentation_scope"
  - "extracted_facts"
  - "architecture_decision"
  - "documentation_outline"
  - "diagram_inventory"
  - "draft_path"
  - "validation_exit_code"
  - "review_decision"
  - "deliverable_path"

default_context:
  source_paths: []
  audience: null
  outcomes: []
  documentation_scope: null
  extracted_facts: []
  architecture_decision: null
  documentation_outline: null
  diagram_inventory: []
  draft_path: null
  validation_exit_code: null
  review_decision: null
  deliverable_path: null

states:
  INTAKE:
    description: "Collect source paths, audience, outcomes, and documentation scope"
    prompt_template: "states/intake.md"
    tools: ["view_file", "find_by_name", "grep_search"]
    transitions:
      INTAKE_READY:
        target: "DISCOVER"
        guard: "Array.isArray(event.payload.source_paths) && event.payload.source_paths.length > 0 && event.payload.audience != null && Array.isArray(event.payload.outcomes)"
      INTAKE_INVALID:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "!(Array.isArray(event.payload.source_paths) && event.payload.source_paths.length > 0 && event.payload.audience != null && Array.isArray(event.payload.outcomes))"

  DISCOVER:
    description: "Inventory source files and identify authoritative documentation inputs"
    prompt_template: "states/discover.md"
    tools: ["find_by_name", "grep_search", "view_file"]
    transitions:
      DISCOVERY_COMPLETE:
        target: "EXTRACT"
        guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
      DISCOVERY_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.exit_code !== 0"

  EXTRACT:
    description: "Extract facts, APIs, decisions, interfaces, and operational constraints"
    prompt_template: "states/extract.md"
    model:
      tier: reasoning
      temperature: 0.1
    tools: ["view_file", "grep_search", "run_command"]
    transitions:
      FACTS_EXTRACTED:
        target: "DESIGN"
        guard: "Array.isArray(event.payload.extracted_facts) && event.payload.extracted_facts.length > 0"
      EXTRACTION_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "!Array.isArray(event.payload.extracted_facts) || event.payload.extracted_facts.length === 0"

  DESIGN:
    description: "Choose information architecture and map content to audience outcomes"
    prompt_template: "states/design.md"
    model:
      tier: reasoning
      temperature: 0.1
    tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file"]
    transitions:
      ARCHITECTURE_DESIGNED:
        target: "AUTHOR"
        guard: "event.payload.architecture_decision != null && Array.isArray(event.payload.documentation_outline) && event.payload.documentation_outline.length > 0"
      DESIGN_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.architecture_decision == null || !Array.isArray(event.payload.documentation_outline) || event.payload.documentation_outline.length === 0"

  AUTHOR:
    description: "Draft concise, source-linked documentation from the approved outline"
    prompt_template: "states/author.md"
    model:
      tier: balanced
      temperature: 0.1
    tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file", "grep_search"]
    transitions:
      DRAFT_WRITTEN:
        target: "DIAGRAM"
        guard: "event.payload.draft_path != null && event.payload.draft_path.length > 0"
      AUTHORING_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.draft_path == null || event.payload.draft_path.length === 0"

  DIAGRAM:
    description: "Create embedded diagrams from documented relationships and decisions"
    prompt_template: "states/diagram.md"
    tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file", "run_command"]
    transitions:
      DIAGRAMS_EMBEDDED:
        target: "VALIDATE"
        guard: "Array.isArray(event.payload.diagram_inventory) && event.payload.diagram_inventory.length > 0"
      DIAGRAM_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "!Array.isArray(event.payload.diagram_inventory) || event.payload.diagram_inventory.length === 0"

  VALIDATE:
    description: "Check links, terminology, source traceability, diagram integrity, and readability"
    prompt_template: "states/validate.md"
    model:
      tier: fast
      temperature: 0.1
    tools: ["run_command", "view_file", "grep_search"]
    transitions:
      VALIDATION_PASSED:
        target: "REVIEW"
        guard: "event.payload.validation_exit_code === 0"
        judgment:
          type: predicate
          adapter_hint: script
          criterion: "payload.validation_exit_code === 0 && Array.isArray(payload.validation_checks) && payload.validation_checks.length > 0 && payload.validation_checks.every(check => check && check.passed === true)"
          min_confidence: 0.9
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: "ERROR"
      VALIDATION_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.validation_exit_code !== 0"

  REVIEW:
    description: "Human review gate for accuracy, usefulness, and publication readiness"
    prompt_template: "states/review.md"
    tools: ["view_file"]
    human_gate:
      type: "choice"
      tool: "ask_question"
      options:
        - "Approve and publish"
        - "Request revisions"
        - "Reject publication"
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: "SUCCESS"
        guard: "event.payload.approved === true"
      USER_REQUEST_REVISIONS:
        target: "AUTHOR"
        guard: "event.payload.revisions_requested === true"
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.rejected === true"

  SUCCESS:
    description: "Terminal state: validated documentation architecture is published"
    prompt_template: "states/success.md"

  BLOCKED:
    description: "Terminal state: publication rejected or blocked by review"
    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"

  ERROR:
    description: "Terminal state: documentation workflow failed"
    prompt_template: "states/error.md"

deliverable_projections:
  - template: "templates/documentation_architecture.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/docs-architect/documentation-architecture.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]
  - template: "templates/diagram_inventory.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/docs-architect/diagram-inventory.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]
  - template: "templates/state_snapshot.json.hbs"
    output: ".docs/docs-architect/state.json"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]

strict_execution: true

  selected_runtime:
    type: object
    nullable: true
  task:
    type: object
    nullable: true

    type: object
    nullable: true
  approval:
    type: object
    nullable: true

    type: object
    nullable: true
  baseline:

    nullable: true

    type: object

  assessment: null
  progress:

  history: []
  pause: null
  confirmation: null
  consumed_confirmation_cases: []
  stop: null
  report: null
states:
  INIT:
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    model:
      tier: fast
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: ACTIVE
        guardFunction: guards/runtime-ready.cjs
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: BYPASS_DETECTED
        guardFunction: guards/setup-required.cjs
  ACTIVE:
    prompt_template: states/active/parent.md
    model:
      tier: balanced
    transitions:
      CANCEL:
        target: ACTIVE.FINALIZE
        guardFunction: guards/cancel.cjs
      DEPENDENCY_FAILED:
        target: ACTIVE.FINALIZE
        guardFunction: guards/dependency-failed.cjs
      CONTRACT_CHANGED:
        target: ACTIVE.CONTRACT
        guardFunction: guards/contract-changed.cjs
      PAUSE:
        target: PAUSED
        guardFunction: guards/pause.cjs
    initial_substate: INTAKE
    substates:
      INTAKE:
        prompt_template: states/active/intake.md
        model:
          tier: reasoning
        transitions:
          INTAKE_READY:
            target: ACTIVE.CONTRACT
            guardFunction: guards/intake-ready.cjs
      CONTRACT:
        prompt_template: states/active/contract.md
        model:
          tier: decision
        transitions:
          CONTRACT_APPROVED:
            target: ACTIVE.CALIBRATE
            guardFunction: guards/contract-approved.cjs
      CALIBRATE:
        prompt_template: states/active/calibrate.md
        model:
          tier: reasoning
        transitions:
          CALIBRATION_PASSED:
            target: ACTIVE.BASELINE
            guardFunction: guards/calibration-passed.cjs
      BASELINE:
        prompt_template: states/active/baseline.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          BASELINE_MEASURED:
            target: ACTIVE.TRIAL
            guardFunction: guards/baseline-measured.cjs
          BUDGET_EXHAUSTED:
            target: ACTIVE.FINALIZE
            guardFunction: guards/budget-exhausted.cjs
      TRIAL:
        prompt_template: states/active/trial/parent.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          SEARCH_FINISHED:
            target: ACTIVE.CONFIRM
            guardFunction: guards/search-finished.cjs
          NO_CANDIDATE:
            target: ACTIVE.FINALIZE
            guardFunction: guards/no-candidate.cjs
          BUDGET_EXHAUSTED:
            target: ACTIVE.FINALIZE
            guardFunction: guards/budget-exhausted.cjs
        initial_substate: DIAGNOSE
        substates:
          DIAGNOSE:
            prompt_template: states/active/trial/diagnose.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              DIAGNOSIS_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.PROPOSE
                guardFunction: guards/diagnosis-ready.cjs
          PROPOSE:
            prompt_template: states/active/trial/propose.md
            model:
              tier: reasoning
            transitions:
              PROPOSAL_READY:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.RUN
                guardFunction: guards/proposal-ready.cjs
          RUN:
            prompt_template: states/active/trial/run.md
            model:
              tier: balanced
            transitions:
              TRIAL_MEASURED:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.ASSESS
                guardFunction: guards/trial-measured.cjs
              TRIAL_FAILED:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.ASSESS
                guardFunction: guards/trial-failed.cjs
              TRIAL_INVALID:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.ASSESS
                guardFunction: guards/trial-invalid.cjs
          ASSESS:
            prompt_template: states/active/trial/assess.md
            model:
              tier: decision
            transitions:
              CANDIDATE_ACCEPTED:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.DIAGNOSE
                guardFunction: guards/candidate-accepted.cjs
              CANDIDATE_REJECTED:
                target: ACTIVE.TRIAL.DIAGNOSE
                guardFunction: guards/candidate-rejected.cjs
      CONFIRM:
        prompt_template: states/active/confirm.md
        model:
          tier: reasoning
        transitions:
          CONFIRMATION_MEASURED:
            target: ACTIVE.FINALIZE
            guardFunction: guards/confirmation-measured.cjs
      FINALIZE:
        prompt_template: states/active/finalize.md
        model:
          tier: balanced
        transitions:
          REPORT_READY:
            target: COMPLETE
            guardFunction: guards/report-ready.cjs
          REPORT_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
            guardFunction: guards/report-blocked.cjs
  PAUSED:
    prompt_template: states/paused.md
    model:
      tier: balanced
    transitions:
      RESUME_INTAKE:
        target: ACTIVE.INTAKE
        guardFunction: guards/resume-intake.cjs
      RESUME_CONTRACT:
        target: ACTIVE.CONTRACT
        guardFunction: guards/resume-contract.cjs
      RESUME_CALIBRATION:

    trigger_on: [VERIFY_PASSED, VERIFY_FAILED, VERIFY_DEFERRED, TEST_PASSED, TEST_FAILED, TEST_DEFERRED, DOD_AUDIT_PASSED, DOD_AUDIT_REPAIR_REQUIRED, DOD_AUDIT_BLOCKED]
  - template: templates/review.md.hbs

    trigger_on: [REVIEW_PASSED, REVIEW_FINDINGS, REVIEW_DEFERRED]

    output: "{{context.artifact_base}}/{{context.run_id}}/handoff.md"
    trigger_on: [DOD_AUDIT_PASSED, SYNC_BLOCKED]
  - template: templates/dod.md.hbs
    output: "{{context.artifact_base}}/{{context.run_id}}/dod.md"
    trigger_on: [USER_APPROVED, USER_REVISION_REQUESTED, USER_REJECTED, DOD_CHANGE_REQUESTED, DOD_AUDIT_PASSED, DOD_AUDIT_REPAIR_REQUIRED, DOD_AUDIT_BLOCKED]
states:
  INIT:
    description: Verify reactive runtime before any lifecycle work.
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: ACTIVE
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: ERROR
  ACTIVE:
    description: Owns every nonterminal SDLC phase and handles lifecycle-wide decision reopening.
    initial_substate: INTAKE
    transitions:
      DECISION_REOPENED:
        target: ACTIVE.ARCHITECT
        guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
      DOD_CHANGE_REQUESTED:
        target: ACTIVE.DOD_AMENDMENT
        guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
    substates:
      INTAKE:
        description: Capture the work request, repo state, and completion target.
        prompt_template: states/intake.md
        transitions:
          WORK_REQUEST_READY:
            target: ACTIVE.SCOPE
            guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
          BUG_FIX_REQUESTED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_APPROVAL
            guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
          AUDIT_REQUESTED:
            target: ACTIVE.AUDIT
            guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
          DIRECT_BUILD_REQUESTED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_APPROVAL
            guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
          INTAKE_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
            guardFunction: guards/run-id.cjs
      SCOPE:
        description: Convert the request into ordered work with acceptance seeds.
        prompt_template: states/scope.md
        transitions:
          SCOPE_READY:
            target: ACTIVE.ARCHITECT
          SCOPE_ONLY:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_APPROVAL
          SCOPE_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
      ARCHITECT:
        description: Settle load bearing design decisions before implementation.
        prompt_template: states/architect.md
        transitions:
          SPEC_READY:
            target: ACTIVE.AUDIT
          DOD_AMENDMENT_REQUIRED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_AMENDMENT
          DECISION_DEFERRED:
            target: BLOCKED
          DESIGN_FLAW_CONFIRMED:
            target: ACTIVE.SCOPE
      AUDIT:
        description: Ensure durable project context exists and matches the work area.
        prompt_template: states/audit.md
        transitions:
          CONTEXT_READY:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_APPROVAL
          CONTEXT_REFRESHED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP
          AUDIT_TO_SCOPE:
            target: ACTIVE.SCOPE
          CONTEXT_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
      DOD_APPROVAL:
        description: Present the complete outcome contract and collect one approval before implementation.
        prompt_template: states/dod_approval.md
        human_gate:
          type: choice
          tool: ask_question
          options:
            - Approve DoD
            - Request DoD Changes
            - Stop
        transitions:
          USER_APPROVED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP
            guardFunction: guards/dod-structure.cjs
          USER_REVISION_REQUESTED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_APPROVAL
          USER_REJECTED:
            target: BLOCKED
      DOD_AMENDMENT:
        description: Approve a focused DoD diff after an accepted outcome or load-bearing decision changes.
        prompt_template: states/dod_amendment.md
        human_gate:
          type: choice
          tool: ask_question
          options:
            - Approve DoD Diff
            - Request DoD Changes
            - Stop
        transitions:
          USER_APPROVED:
            target: ACTIVE.AUDIT
            guardFunction: guards/dod-structure.cjs
          USER_REVISION_REQUESTED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_AMENDMENT
          USER_REJECTED:
            target: BLOCKED
      DOD_AUDIT:
        description: Check every approved criterion, capture evidence, and route failures for repair.
        prompt_template: states/dod_audit.md
        transitions:
          DOD_CHECK_SUBMITTED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_AUDIT
            judgment:
              type: predicate
              # Jev sees the signal payload as `event`; the stored context still holds the previous check, so only the signal's check counts.
              criterion: "Does the delivered output satisfy the single approved assertion in `event.contextUpdates.dod_record.active_check.question`, based only on that check's `expected_result` and `evidence`? Answer no when this signal carries no active check."
              min_probability: 0.85
              # The check travels in the payload, and the stored context holds the previous one, so send the payload and no context.
              context_paths: []
              include_payload: true
              adapter_hint: jev
              fallback_target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP
          DOD_AUDIT_PASSED:
            target: COMPLETE
            # Guards read the stored context before this signal's contextUpdates merge, so check the record this signal would store.
            guard: "(record => Boolean(record) && Array.isArray(record.criteria) && record.criteria.length > 0 && record.criteria.every(item => item && item.status === 'passed' && typeof item.evidence === 'string' && item.evidence.trim().length > 0))((payload.contextUpdates && payload.contextUpdates.dod_record) || context.dod_record)"
          DOD_AUDIT_REPAIR_REQUIRED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP
          DOD_AUDIT_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
      DEVELOP:
        description: Implement the scoped and designed change.
        prompt_template: states/develop.md
        transitions:
          DEBUG_NEEDED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEBUG
          BUILD_SKIPPED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_AUDIT
          BUILD_READY:
            target: ACTIVE.VERIFY
          DECISION_NEEDED:
            target: ACTIVE.ARCHITECT
          BUILD_FAILED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEBUG
      VERIFY:
        description: Prove behavior in the real product or service.
        prompt_template: states/verify.md
        transitions:
          VERIFY_PASSED:
            target: ACTIVE.TEST
          VERIFY_FAILED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEBUG
          VERIFY_DEFERRED:
            target: ACTIVE.TEST
      TEST:
        description: Write or update tests for durable behavior.
        prompt_template: states/test.md
        transitions:
          TEST_PASSED:
            target: ACTIVE.REVIEW
          TEST_FAILED:
            target: ACTIVE.DEBUG
          TEST_DEFERRED:
            target: ACTIVE.REVIEW
      DEBUG:
        description: Reproduce failures, prove the root cause, apply the smallest fix, and verify it.
        prompt_template: states/debug.md
        transitions:
          BUG_FIXED:
            target: ACTIVE.VERIFY
            # Three repair attempts per failure: the attempt must follow the stored one for the same failure_id, or restart at 1.
            guard: "((prev, next) => Boolean(next) && typeof next.failure_id === 'string' && next.failure_id.trim().length > 0 && typeof next.failure_evidence === 'string' && next.failure_evidence.trim().length > 0 && next.attempt === (prev && prev.failure_id === next.failure_id ? Number(prev.attempt) || 0 : 0) + 1 && next.attempt <= 3)(context.debug_record, payload.contextUpdates && payload.contextUpdates.debug_record)"
          DESIGN_FLAW:
            target: ACTIVE.ARCHITECT
          DEBUG_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
      REVIEW:
        description: Review the diff for defects, risks, and missed requirements.
        prompt_template: states/review.md
        transitions:
          REVIEW_PASSED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOCUMENT
            # Only the signal's own record counts, so a stale review from an earlier pass cannot satisfy a new one.
            guard: "(reviewer => Boolean(reviewer) && reviewer.isolation === 'fresh_context' && typeof reviewer.agent === 'string' && reviewer.agent.trim().length > 0)(((payload.contextUpdates && payload.contextUpdates.review_record) || {}).reviewer)"
          REVIEW_FINDINGS:
            target: ACTIVE.DEVELOP
          REVIEW_DEFERRED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOCUMENT
      DOCUMENT:
        description: Write human facing change prose from evidence.
        prompt_template: states/document.md
        transitions:
          DOCUMENTED:
            target: ACTIVE.SYNC
          DOCUMENT_DEFERRED:
            target: ACTIVE.SYNC
      SYNC:
        description: Reconcile durable context, scope status, and decision status from repo evidence.
        prompt_template: states/sync.md
        transitions:
          SYNCED:
            target: ACTIVE.DOD_AUDIT
          SYNC_BLOCKED:
            target: BLOCKED
  COMPLETE:
    description: Report success after every approved DoD criterion passes with evidence.
    prompt_template: states/complete.md
  BLOCKED:
    description: Report blocked or stopped work and its unmet DoD item or missing decision.
    prompt_template: states/blocked.md
  ERROR:
    description: Runtime setup failed or execution became unsafe.
    prompt_template: states/error.md
  BYPASS_DETECTED:
    description: Bypass detected because execution moved outside the signal contract.
    prompt_template: states/bypass_detected.md

    tools:

      - view_file
    transitions:

        target: BASELINING
      INSPECTION_FAILED:
        target: ERROR

    prompt_template: states/baselining.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      BASELINE_PASSED:
        target: MUTATING
        guard: payload.exit_code === 0
      BASELINE_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code !== 0
  MUTATING:
    description: Synthesize AST/token mutants and apply differential filters
    prompt_template: states/mutating.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
    transitions:
      MUTANTS_GENERATED:
        target: EXECUTING
      MUTATION_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  EXECUTING:
    description: Execute test suite across mutants with in-place swap and atomic rollback
    prompt_template: states/executing.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      EXECUTION_COMPLETED:
        target: PROJECTING
      EXECUTION_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  PROJECTING:
    description: Calculate mutation scorecard metrics and generate deliverable projections
    prompt_template: states/projecting.md
    tools:

    transitions:

        target: READY

    description: "Collect PR metadata, checks, reviews, diffs, and ownership signals"

        target: "ROUTE"
        guard: "Array.isArray(event.payload.assessments) && event.payload.assessments.length > 0"
        judgment:
          type: predicate
          adapter_hint: script
          criterion: "Array.isArray(payload.assessments) && payload.assessments.length > 0 && payload.assessments.every(item => item && item.status && item.evidence)"
          min_confidence: 0.85
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: "ASSESS"
      ASSESSMENT_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "!Array.isArray(event.payload.assessments) || event.payload.assessments.length === 0"

  ROUTE:
    description: "Build deterministic routing and disposition recommendations"

    model:

      temperature: 0.1
    tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file"]
    transitions:

        target: "REVIEW"

    human_gate:

      USER_REJECTED:

    prompt_template: "states/success.md"

  BLOCKED:

    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"

  existing product feature enhancements), strategic goal alignment, SMART requirement

context_keys:
  - product_name
  - opportunity_type
  - target_persona
  - problem_statement
  - worthwhileness_score

  - anti_goals

states:

    transitions:

        target: SELECT_OPPORTUNITY_TYPE
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: SETUP_RUNTIME

    description: "Auto-configure harness MCP server or reactive CLI"
    prompt_template: states/setup_runtime.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      SETUP_COMPLETE:
        target: SELECT_OPPORTUNITY_TYPE
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      SETUP_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0

  SELECT_OPPORTUNITY_TYPE:
    description: "Classify opportunity: NEW_PRODUCT (green-field) vs PRODUCT_ENHANCEMENT (existing product feature)"
    prompt_template: states/select_opportunity_type.md
    tools:
      - ask_question
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      OPPORTUNITY_SELECTED:
        target: RESEARCH_DISCOVERY
        guard: context.opportunity_type != null

  RESEARCH_DISCOVERY:
    description: "Investigate problem space, target persona, market/user evidence, and competitive landscape"
    prompt_template: states/research_discovery.md
    model:
      tier: reasoning

    tools:

    transitions:

      PIVOT_INTAKE:
        target: SELECT_OPPORTUNITY_TYPE

  VALIDATE_WORTHWHILENESS:
    description: "Assess Desirability, Feasibility, Viability, and Defensibility to verify if pursuit is worthwhile"
    prompt_template: states/validate_worthwhileness.md
    model:
      tier: decision
      temperature: 0.1
    tools:
      - ask_question
      - view_file
    transitions:
      WORTHWHILE_CONFIRMED:
        target: ALIGN_GOALS
        judgment:
          type: predicate
          adapter_hint: script
          criterion: "Number(payload.worthwhileness_score) >= 3 && payload.catastrophic_blocker !== true && payload.axis_scores != null && payload.axis_scores.desirability != null && payload.axis_scores.feasibility != null && payload.axis_scores.viability != null && payload.axis_scores.timing != null"
          min_confidence: 0.85
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: REVIEW_GATE

        target: REVIEW_GATE

    description: "Align product outcomes with overarching strategic vision, North Star metric, and explicit anti-goals"
    prompt_template: states/align_goals.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      GOALS_ALIGNED:
        target: GATHER_TEST_REQUIREMENTS
      REALIGN_RESEARCH:
        target: RESEARCH_DISCOVERY

    description: "Gather functional and non-functional requirements and test them with falsification checks"
    prompt_template: states/gather_test_requirements.md
    tools:
      - ask_question
      - view_file
      - grep_search
    transitions:
      REQUIREMENTS_TESTED:
        target: FORMULATE_SMART
      REVISE_GOALS:
        target: ALIGN_GOALS

    description: "Scope vetted requirements into Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound specifications"

    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:

        target: EISENHOWER_PRIORITIZATION

        target: GATHER_TEST_REQUIREMENTS

    description: "Prioritize scope using Eisenhower Matrix: Q1 Do Now, Q2 Schedule, Q3 Delegate/Ops, Q4 Defer/Reject"
    prompt_template: states/eisenhower_prioritize.md
    model:
      tier: decision
      temperature: 0.1
    tools:
      - ask_question
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
    transitions:
      PRIORITIZATION_COMPLETE:
        target: VERTICAL_SLICING
      REVISE_SCOPE:
        target: FORMULATE_SMART

  VERTICAL_SLICING:
    description: "Decompose prioritized scope into end-to-end deliverable vertical slices and define MVP boundary"
    prompt_template: states/vertical_slicing.md
    model:
      tier: reasoning
      temperature: 0.1
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      SLICES_DECOMPOSED:
        target: REVIEW_GATE
      REVISE_PRIORITIES:
        target: EISENHOWER_PRIORITIZATION

  REVIEW_GATE:
    description: "Human Gate: Review and approve consolidated Lean Product Charter, Eisenhower Matrix, and Slices"
    prompt_template: states/review_gate.md
    human_gate:
      type: choice
      tool: ask_question
      options:
        - Approve Product Slices & Prioritization
        - Revise Vertical Slices
        - Revise Eisenhower Prioritization
        - Continue Despite Doubts
        - Abort Opportunity
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: PROJECTING
        judgment:
          type: predicate
          adapter_hint: script
          criterion: "Number(context.worthwhileness_score) >= 3 && Array.isArray(context.strategic_goals) && Array.isArray(context.vertical_slices) && context.vertical_slices.length > 0 && Array.isArray(context.mvp_slice_ids) && context.mvp_slice_ids.length > 0"
          min_confidence: 0.85
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: VERTICAL_SLICING
      REVISE_SLICES:
        target: VERTICAL_SLICING
      REVISE_PRIORITIES:
        target: EISENHOWER_PRIORITIZATION
      CONTINUE_DESPITE_DOUBTS:
        target: ALIGN_GOALS
        guard: "!Array.isArray(context.vertical_slices) || context.vertical_slices.length === 0"
      ABORT:
        target: ERROR

  PROJECTING:
    description: "Render and write deliverable markdown specs, matrices, and catalog inventory"
    prompt_template: states/projecting.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - view_file
    transitions:
      PROJECTED:
        target: SUCCESS

  SUCCESS:
    description: "Terminal success state summarizing approved product slices and execution handover"
    prompt_template: states/success.md

    description: "Terminal error state with diagnostic logs and triage instructions"
    prompt_template: states/error.md
    tools:
