description: >-
  One reactive entry point that helps users explore, choose, plan, or review a
  quantitative, qualitative, or mixed methods research design.
initial_state: INIT
strict_execution: true
context_keys:
  - requested_task
  - study_topic
  - research_problem
  - research_purpose
  - intended_audience
  - research_questions
  - hypotheses
  - worldview
  - literature_gap
  - theory_or_framework
  - decision_kind
  - selected_choice
  - selected_approach
  - quantitative_design
  - qualitative_strategy
  - mixed_methods_design
  - design_notes
  - ethics_notes
  - missing_information
  - review_mode
  - output_scope
  - judgment_fallback
default_context:
  requested_task: null
  study_topic: null
  research_problem: null
  research_purpose: null
  intended_audience: null
  research_questions: []
  hypotheses: []
  worldview: null
  literature_gap: null
  theory_or_framework: null
  decision_kind: null
  selected_choice: null
  selected_approach: null
  quantitative_design: null
  qualitative_strategy: null
  mixed_methods_design: null
  design_notes: []
  ethics_notes: []
  missing_information: []
  review_mode: false
  output_scope: null
  judgment_fallback: false
states:
  INIT:
    description: Verify access to the reactive runtime.
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: INTAKE
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: SETUP_RUNTIME
  SETUP_RUNTIME:
    description: Explain the runtime setup requirement and wait for a user-controlled retry.
    prompt_template: states/setup_runtime.md
    transitions:
      SETUP_COMPLETE:
        target: INIT
      SETUP_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  INTAKE:
    description: Accept a complete request or a starting point, including uncertainty.
    prompt_template: states/intake.md
    transitions:
      INTAKE_COMPLETE:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      NEED_CLARIFICATION:
        target: CLARIFY
      EXISTING_PLAN_REVIEW:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
  CLARIFY:
    description: Resolve one decision or missing detail at a time.
    prompt_template: states/clarify.md
    transitions:
      CLARIFIED:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      ROUTE_FOUNDATIONS:
        target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
      ROUTE_APPROACH:
        target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_APPROACH
      ROUTE_PROPOSAL:
        target: PROPOSAL.SECTION_ROUTER
      ROUTE_QUANTITATIVE:
        target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_QUANTITATIVE_DESIGN
      ROUTE_QUALITATIVE:
        target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_QUALITATIVE_STRATEGY
      ROUTE_MIXED_METHODS:
        target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_MIXED_METHODS_DESIGN
      ROUTE_REVIEW:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
      USER_CANCELLED:
        target: DONE
  DECISIONS:
    description: Composite routing and bounded method selection.
    prompt_template: states/decisions/_parent.md
    initial_substate: ROUTE_TASK
    transitions:
      USER_CANCELLED:
        target: DONE
      NEED_CLARIFICATION:
        target: CLARIFY
    substates:
      ROUTE_TASK:
        description: Select the smallest useful work path.
        prompt_template: states/decisions/route_task.md
        transitions:
          USER_CHOICE_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "route_task" && ["explore_or_clarify_goal","choose_research_approach","work_on_proposal_section","plan_quantitative_methods","plan_qualitative_methods","plan_mixed_methods","review_existing_plan","other"].includes(payload.choice)
          RECOMMENDATION_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "route_task" && ["explore_or_clarify_goal","choose_research_approach","work_on_proposal_section","plan_quantitative_methods","plan_qualitative_methods","plan_mixed_methods","review_existing_plan","other"].includes(payload.choice)
            judgment:
              type: categorical
              criterion: "Which allowed work path best fits the user's stated need and relevant non-identifying study context?"
              options: ["explore_or_clarify_goal","choose_research_approach","work_on_proposal_section","plan_quantitative_methods","plan_qualitative_methods","plan_mixed_methods","review_existing_plan","other"]
              min_confidence: 0.7
              adapter_hint: jev
              fallback_adapter: jev
              fallback_target: CLARIFY
      CHOOSE_APPROACH:
        description: Select or recommend a research approach from the stated problem and purpose.
        prompt_template: states/decisions/choose_approach.md
        transitions:
          USER_CHOICE_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "research_approach" && ["quantitative","qualitative","mixed_methods","other"].includes(payload.choice)
          RECOMMENDATION_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "research_approach" && ["quantitative","qualitative","mixed_methods","other"].includes(payload.choice)
            judgment:
              type: categorical
              criterion: "Which allowed research approach best fits the problem, purpose, questions, audience, and available information?"
              options: ["quantitative","qualitative","mixed_methods","other"]
              min_confidence: 0.7
              adapter_hint: jev
              fallback_adapter: jev
              fallback_target: CLARIFY
      CHOOSE_QUANTITATIVE_DESIGN:
        description: Select or recommend a survey or experimental design.
        prompt_template: states/decisions/choose_quantitative_design.md
        transitions:
          USER_CHOICE_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "quantitative_design" && ["survey","experiment","other"].includes(payload.choice)
          RECOMMENDATION_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "quantitative_design" && ["survey","experiment","other"].includes(payload.choice)
            judgment:
              type: categorical
              criterion: "Which allowed quantitative design best fits the questions, variables, comparison needs, and feasible data collection?"
              options: ["survey","experiment","other"]
              min_confidence: 0.7
              adapter_hint: jev
              fallback_adapter: jev
              fallback_target: CLARIFY
      CHOOSE_QUALITATIVE_STRATEGY:
        description: Select or recommend a qualitative strategy.
        prompt_template: states/decisions/choose_qualitative_strategy.md
        transitions:
          USER_CHOICE_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "qualitative_strategy" && ["narrative","phenomenology","ethnography","case_study","grounded_theory","other"].includes(payload.choice)
          RECOMMENDATION_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "qualitative_strategy" && ["narrative","phenomenology","ethnography","case_study","grounded_theory","other"].includes(payload.choice)
            judgment:
              type: categorical
              criterion: "Which allowed qualitative strategy best fits the phenomenon, unit of analysis, setting, and intended understanding?"
              options: ["narrative","phenomenology","ethnography","case_study","grounded_theory","other"]
              min_confidence: 0.7
              adapter_hint: jev
              fallback_adapter: jev
              fallback_target: CLARIFY
      CHOOSE_MIXED_METHODS_DESIGN:
        description: Select or recommend a mixed methods design.
        prompt_template: states/decisions/choose_mixed_methods_design.md
        transitions:
          USER_CHOICE_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "mixed_methods_design" && ["convergent","explanatory_sequential","exploratory_sequential","complex","other"].includes(payload.choice)
          RECOMMENDATION_SUBMITTED:
            target: DECISIONS.DISPATCH
            guard: payload.decision_kind === "mixed_methods_design" && ["convergent","explanatory_sequential","exploratory_sequential","complex","other"].includes(payload.choice)
            judgment:
              type: categorical
              criterion: "Which allowed mixed methods design best fits the purpose for combining strands, their sequence, priority, and integration point?"
              options: ["convergent","explanatory_sequential","exploratory_sequential","complex","other"]
              min_confidence: 0.7
              adapter_hint: jev
              fallback_adapter: jev
              fallback_target: CLARIFY
      DISPATCH:
        description: Route a validated choice using exact membership and decision-kind checks.
        prompt_template: states/decisions/_parent.md
        transitions:
          GO_FOUNDATIONS:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
            guard: context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "explore_or_clarify_goal"
          GO_APPROACH:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_APPROACH
            guard: context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "choose_research_approach"
          GO_PROPOSAL:
            target: PROPOSAL.SECTION_ROUTER
            guard: context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "work_on_proposal_section"
          GO_QUANTITATIVE:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_QUANTITATIVE_DESIGN
            guard: (context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "plan_quantitative_methods") || (context.decision_kind === "research_approach" && context.selected_choice === "quantitative")
          GO_QUALITATIVE:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_QUALITATIVE_STRATEGY
            guard: (context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "plan_qualitative_methods") || (context.decision_kind === "research_approach" && context.selected_choice === "qualitative")
          GO_MIXED_METHODS:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_MIXED_METHODS_DESIGN
            guard: (context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "plan_mixed_methods") || (context.decision_kind === "research_approach" && context.selected_choice === "mixed_methods")
          GO_SURVEY:
            target: QUANTITATIVE.SURVEY
            guard: context.decision_kind === "quantitative_design" && context.selected_choice === "survey"
          GO_EXPERIMENT:
            target: QUANTITATIVE.EXPERIMENT
            guard: context.decision_kind === "quantitative_design" && context.selected_choice === "experiment"
          GO_QUAL_STRATEGY:
            target: QUALITATIVE.ACCESS_SAMPLING_COLLECTION
            guard: context.decision_kind === "qualitative_strategy" && ["narrative","phenomenology","ethnography","case_study","grounded_theory"].includes(context.selected_choice)
          GO_MIXED_DESIGN:
            target: MIXED_METHODS.STRAND_PROCEDURES
            guard: context.decision_kind === "mixed_methods_design" && ["convergent","explanatory_sequential","exploratory_sequential","complex"].includes(context.selected_choice)
          GO_REVIEW:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
            guard: context.decision_kind === "route_task" && context.selected_choice === "review_existing_plan"
          GO_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
            guard: context.selected_choice === "other" || context.selected_choice == null || context.judgment_fallback === true
  FOUNDATIONS:
    description: Composite foundations for problem framing, literature, theory, writing, and ethics.
    prompt_template: states/foundations/_parent.md
    initial_substate: TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
    transitions:
      RETURN_TO_ROUTER:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      RETURN_TO_INTAKE:
        target: INTAKE
      FINISH_SECTION:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
    substates:
      TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM:
        description: Shape a feasible research problem from a topic or concern.
        prompt_template: states/foundations/topic_and_problem.md
        transitions:
          CONTINUE_TO_LITERATURE:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.LITERATURE_AND_THEORY
          CONTINUE_TO_ETHICS:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.WRITING_AND_ETHICS
          SELECT_APPROACH:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_APPROACH
          SELECT_PROPOSAL_SECTION:
            target: PROPOSAL.SECTION_ROUTER
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      LITERATURE_AND_THEORY:
        description: Frame a literature review, gap, and role for theory or a conceptual framework.
        prompt_template: states/foundations/literature_and_theory.md
        transitions:
          CONTINUE_TO_PROBLEM:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
          CONTINUE_TO_ETHICS:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.WRITING_AND_ETHICS
          SELECT_APPROACH:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_APPROACH
          SELECT_PROPOSAL_SECTION:
            target: PROPOSAL.SECTION_ROUTER
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      WRITING_AND_ETHICS:
        description: Apply writing and ethics considerations throughout the design.
        prompt_template: states/foundations/writing_and_ethics.md
        transitions:
          RETURN_TO_PROBLEM:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
          SELECT_APPROACH:
            target: DECISIONS.CHOOSE_APPROACH
          SELECT_PROPOSAL_SECTION:
            target: PROPOSAL.SECTION_ROUTER
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
  PROPOSAL:
    description: Composite route for introduction, purpose or aim, and questions or hypotheses.
    prompt_template: states/proposal/_parent.md
    initial_substate: SECTION_ROUTER
    transitions:
      RETURN_TO_FOUNDATIONS:
        target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
      RETURN_TO_ROUTER:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      FINISH_SECTION:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
    substates:
      SECTION_ROUTER:
        description: Choose the requested proposal section and load only that prompt.
        prompt_template: states/proposal/_parent.md
        transitions:
          SECTION_INTRODUCTION:
            target: PROPOSAL.INTRODUCTION
          SECTION_PURPOSE:
            target: PROPOSAL.PURPOSE_AND_AIM
          SECTION_QUESTIONS:
            target: PROPOSAL.QUESTIONS_AND_HYPOTHESES
          SECTION_OTHER:
            target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
      INTRODUCTION:
        description: Build the proposal introduction and justify the study.
        prompt_template: states/proposal/introduction.md
        transitions:
          SECTION_PURPOSE:
            target: PROPOSAL.PURPOSE_AND_AIM
          SECTION_QUESTIONS:
            target: PROPOSAL.QUESTIONS_AND_HYPOTHESES
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      PURPOSE_AND_AIM:
        description: State the study purpose or aim and its alignment.
        prompt_template: states/proposal/purpose_and_aim.md
        transitions:
          SECTION_INTRODUCTION:
            target: PROPOSAL.INTRODUCTION
          SECTION_QUESTIONS:
            target: PROPOSAL.QUESTIONS_AND_HYPOTHESES
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      QUESTIONS_AND_HYPOTHESES:
        description: Form questions or quantitative hypotheses aligned with the purpose.
        prompt_template: states/proposal/questions_and_hypotheses.md
        transitions:
          SECTION_INTRODUCTION:
            target: PROPOSAL.INTRODUCTION
          SECTION_PURPOSE:
            target: PROPOSAL.PURPOSE_AND_AIM
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
  QUANTITATIVE:
    description: Composite survey, experiment, analysis, preregistration, and validity path.
    prompt_template: states/quantitative/_parent.md
    initial_substate: SURVEY
    transitions:
      RETURN_TO_ROUTER:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      RETURN_TO_FOUNDATIONS:
        target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
      FINISH_DESIGN:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
    substates:
      SURVEY:
        description: Plan survey purpose, population, sampling, instrument, administration, and analysis.
        prompt_template: states/quantitative/survey.md
        transitions:
          CONTINUE_TO_ANALYSIS:
            target: QUANTITATIVE.ANALYSIS_PREREGISTRATION_VALIDITY
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      EXPERIMENT:
        description: Plan an experiment, comparison, assignment, measures, procedure, and analysis.
        prompt_template: states/quantitative/experiment.md
        transitions:
          CONTINUE_TO_ANALYSIS:
            target: QUANTITATIVE.ANALYSIS_PREREGISTRATION_VALIDITY
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      ANALYSIS_PREREGISTRATION_VALIDITY:
        description: Align quantitative analysis, preregistration, validity, reliability, and interpretation.
        prompt_template: states/quantitative/analysis_preregistration_validity.md
        transitions:
          RETURN_TO_SURVEY:
            target: QUANTITATIVE.SURVEY
          RETURN_TO_EXPERIMENT:
            target: QUANTITATIVE.EXPERIMENT
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
  QUALITATIVE:
    description: Composite qualitative strategy, access, sampling, collection, analysis, and reporting path.
    prompt_template: states/qualitative/_parent.md
    initial_substate: ACCESS_SAMPLING_COLLECTION
    transitions:
      RETURN_TO_ROUTER:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      RETURN_TO_FOUNDATIONS:
        target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
      FINISH_DESIGN:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
    substates:
      ACCESS_SAMPLING_COLLECTION:
        description: Plan strategy-specific access, researcher role, sampling, and collection.
        prompt_template: states/qualitative/access_sampling_collection.md
        transitions:
          CONTINUE_TO_ANALYSIS:
            target: QUALITATIVE.ANALYSIS_VALIDATION_REPORTING
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      ANALYSIS_VALIDATION_REPORTING:
        description: Plan iterative analysis, validation, and qualitative reporting.
        prompt_template: states/qualitative/analysis_validation_reporting.md
        transitions:
          RETURN_TO_COLLECTION:
            target: QUALITATIVE.ACCESS_SAMPLING_COLLECTION
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
  MIXED_METHODS:
    description: Composite mixed methods strand procedures, integration, and interpretation path.
    prompt_template: states/mixed_methods/_parent.md
    initial_substate: STRAND_PROCEDURES
    transitions:
      RETURN_TO_ROUTER:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
      RETURN_TO_FOUNDATIONS:
        target: FOUNDATIONS.TOPIC_AND_PROBLEM
      FINISH_DESIGN:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
    substates:
      STRAND_PROCEDURES:
        description: Plan both strands and align order, priority, and timing with the selected design.
        prompt_template: states/mixed_methods/strand_procedures.md
        transitions:
          CONTINUE_TO_INTEGRATION:
            target: MIXED_METHODS.INTEGRATION_AND_INTERPRETATION
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
      INTEGRATION_AND_INTERPRETATION:
        description: Specify integration points, joint displays, and mixed methods interpretations.
        prompt_template: states/mixed_methods/integration_and_interpretation.md
        transitions:
          RETURN_TO_STRANDS:
            target: MIXED_METHODS.STRAND_PROCEDURES
          ASK_CLARIFY:
            target: CLARIFY
          SYNTHESIZE:
            target: SYNTHESIZE
  SYNTHESIZE:
    description: Produce the requested focused design brief or proposal section outline.
    prompt_template: states/synthesize.md
    transitions:
      DELIVERED:
        target: DONE
      REFINE:
        target: CLARIFY
      CONTINUE_DESIGN:
        target: DECISIONS.ROUTE_TASK
  DONE:
    description: Requested research design work has been delivered.
  ERROR:
    description: Runtime is unavailable or a required operation failed.
  BYPASS_DETECTED:
    description: Terminal recovery state for work outside the reactive signal contract.
    prompt_template: states/bypass_detected.md

version: 2.9.0
name: resume-manager
description: >-
  Consolidated reactive career management engine. Orchestrates master profile bootstrapping,
  continuous achievement maintenance, multi-track profile specialization (Senior Technical,
  Practical Mid-Level, Operations Management, Client Solutions, and Adjacent Industry),
  and job application tailoring with automated overqualification and anti-flight risk calibration.
initial_state: INIT
runtime_requirements:
  min_runtime_version: 0.17.0
  required_capabilities:
    - judgment.probability_thresholds
    - judgment.context_paths

context_keys:
  - mode
  - profile_home
  - active_profile_id
  - profiles_dir
  - master_profile_path
  - company_name
  - target_title
  - role_track
  - role_fit
  - role_fit_confidence
  - role_fit_reasons
  - role_fit_gaps
  - overqualified_risk
  - calibration_notes
  - jd_text
  - keywords
  - output_dir
  - resume_path
  - cover_letter_path
  - alignment_path
  - interview_prep_path
  - resume_text
  - cover_letter_text
  - voice_register
  - authenticity_flags
  - unverified_metrics
  - new_achievements
  - project_record
  - selected_projects

  mode: null
  profile_home: "~/.resume-manager"
  active_profile_id: "senior_technical"
  profiles_dir: null
  master_profile_path: null
  company_name: null
  target_title: null
  role_track: "senior_technical"
  role_fit: null
  role_fit_confidence: null
  role_fit_reasons: []
  role_fit_gaps: []
  overqualified_risk: false
  calibration_notes: null
  jd_text: null
  keywords: []
  output_dir: null
  resume_path: null
  cover_letter_path: null
  alignment_path: null
  interview_prep_path: null
  resume_text: null
  cover_letter_text: null
  voice_register: null
  authenticity_flags: []
  unverified_metrics: []
  new_achievements: []
  project_record: []
  selected_projects: []

states:
  INIT:
    description: "Bootloader: Verify reactive runtime environment"
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: SELECT_MODE
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: SETUP_MCP

  SETUP_MCP:
    description: "Auto-configure harness MCP server"
    prompt_template: states/setup_mcp.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      SETUP_COMPLETE:
        target: SELECT_MODE
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      SETUP_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0

  SELECT_MODE:
    description: "Determine operation mode: CUSTOMIZE, MAINTAIN, BOOTSTRAP, or MANAGE_PROFILES"
    prompt_template: states/select_mode.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - find_by_name
      - ask_question
      - run_command
    transitions:
      MODE_CUSTOMIZE:
        target: INGEST_JD
      MODE_MAINTAIN:
        target: INSPECT_PROFILE
      MODE_BOOTSTRAP:
        target: PROFILE_BOOTSTRAP
      MODE_MANAGE_PROFILES:
        target: MANAGE_PROFILES

  PROFILE_BOOTSTRAP:
    description: "Structured career history interview for bootstrapping a new master profile"
    prompt_template: states/profile_bootstrap.md
    tools:
      - ask_question
      - view_file
    transitions:
      INTERVIEW_COMPLETE:
        target: SYNTHESIZE_PROFILES
      ABORT_BOOTSTRAP:
        target: SELECT_MODE

  SYNTHESIZE_PROFILES:
    description: "Synthesize master profile and generate initial multi-track profile archetypes"
    prompt_template: states/synthesize_profiles.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      PROFILES_SYNTHESIZED:
        target: SUCCESS

  INSPECT_PROFILE:
    description: "Inspect existing master profile and select target track to update"
    prompt_template: states/inspect_profile.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - find_by_name
      - ask_question
      - run_command
    transitions:
      PROFILE_LOADED:
        target: RECORD_ACCOMPLISHMENT
      NO_PROFILE_FOUND:
        target: PROFILE_BOOTSTRAP

  RECORD_ACCOMPLISHMENT:
    description: "Capture new role, promotion, win, or skill using Google XYZ / CAR formulas"
    prompt_template: states/record_accomplishment.md
    tools:
      - ask_question
      - view_file
    transitions:
      RECORDED:
        target: PERSIST_PROFILE
      RECORD_MORE:
        target: RECORD_ACCOMPLISHMENT

  PERSIST_PROFILE:
    description: "Persist updated profile records and skill taxonomies to disk"
    prompt_template: states/persist_profile.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - view_file
    transitions:
      PROFILE_SAVED:
        target: SUCCESS

  MANAGE_PROFILES:
    description: "Manage, create, or calibrate multiple specialized profile tracks"
    prompt_template: states/manage_profiles.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      PROFILES_UPDATED:
        target: SUCCESS
      SWITCH_TO_CUSTOMIZE:
        target: INGEST_JD

  INGEST_JD:
    description: "Ingest job posting, extract company, title, responsibilities, and detect industry"
    prompt_template: states/ingest_jd.md
    model:
      tier: balanced
      temperature: 0.1
    tools:
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      JD_INGESTED:
        target: PROFILE_SELECTION
        guard: payload.company_name != null

  PROFILE_SELECTION:
    description: "Match JD to profile track, judge role fit, and evaluate overqualification & flight-risk indicators"
    prompt_template: states/profile_selection.md
    model:
      tier: decision
      temperature: 0.1
    tools:
      - view_file
      - ask_question
      - run_command
    transitions:
      CALIBRATION_REQUIRED:
        target: CALIBRATE_FRAMING
        guard: "payload.overqualified_risk == true && ['strong_fit', 'conditional_fit'].includes(payload.role_fit)"
        judgment:
          type: categorical
          criterion: "Classify candidate role fit as strong_fit, conditional_fit, or weak_fit based on verified experience against job requirements."
          options: ["strong_fit", "conditional_fit", "weak_fit", "other"]
          min_probability: 0.8
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: FIT_REVIEW
      STANDARD_MATCH:
        target: GAP_ANALYSIS
        guard: "payload.overqualified_risk != true && ['strong_fit', 'conditional_fit'].includes(payload.role_fit)"
        judgment:
          type: categorical
          criterion: "Classify candidate role fit as strong_fit, conditional_fit, or weak_fit based on verified experience against job requirements."
          options: ["strong_fit", "conditional_fit", "weak_fit", "other"]
          min_probability: 0.8
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: FIT_REVIEW
      FIT_REVIEW_REQUIRED:
        target: FIT_REVIEW
        guard: "typeof payload.role_fit === 'string' && payload.role_fit.length > 0"

  FIT_REVIEW:
    description: "Human review of weak or low-confidence role fit before application work continues"
    prompt_template: states/fit_review.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    human_gate:
      type: choice
      tool: ask_question
      options:
        - "Proceed with role"
        - "Re-evaluate fit"
        - "Drop role"
    transitions:
      FIT_APPROVED:
        target: GAP_ANALYSIS
        guard: "event.payload.approved === true && context.overqualified_risk !== true"
      FIT_APPROVED_CALIBRATE:
        target: CALIBRATE_FRAMING
        guard: "event.payload.approved === true && context.overqualified_risk === true"
      FIT_REEVALUATE:
        target: PROFILE_SELECTION
        guard: event.payload.reevaluate === true
      FIT_REJECTED:
        target: SELECT_MODE
        guard: event.payload.rejected === true

  CALIBRATE_FRAMING:
    description: "Calibrate language and intent narrative to avoid intimidating or flighty impressions"
    prompt_template: states/calibrate_framing.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      FRAMING_CALIBRATED:
        target: GAP_ANALYSIS

  GAP_ANALYSIS:
    description: "Calibrate 25-35 role-specific keywords and verify candidate experience"
    prompt_template: states/gap_analysis.md
    model:
      tier: reasoning
      temperature: 0.1
    tools:
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      ANALYSIS_COMPLETE:
        target: COMPANY_ALIGNMENT

  COMPANY_ALIGNMENT:
    description: "Research employer context, role mission, public signals, and conversation angles"
    prompt_template: states/company_alignment.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - view_file
    transitions:
      ALIGNMENT_DRAFTED:
        target: DRAFTING

  DRAFTING:
    description: "Draft single-column ATS resume and tailored cover letter adhering to voice and calibration rules"
    prompt_template: states/drafting.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      MATERIALS_DRAFTED:
        target: AUTHENTICITY_REVIEW
        guard: payload.timeline_reconciled == true && payload.unresolved_gap_count == 0
        judgment:
          type: predicate
          criterion: 'Does the cover letter in cover_letter_text follow the voice_register professional voice standards and stay free of AI writing clichés (such as "I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest", "testament to", "delve", "leverage", "synergy"), corporate buzzword slop, and ungrounded flattery?'
          min_probability: 0.75
          # Judge only the text under review; the rest of the run context skews the score.
          context_paths: [cover_letter_text, voice_register]
          include_payload: false
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: DRAFTING

  AUTHENTICITY_REVIEW:
    description: "Audit resume headline and bullets for AI-generated tells and unverified metrics before export"
    prompt_template: states/authenticity_review.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - ask_question
    transitions:
      RESUME_AUTHENTIC:
        target: EXPORTING
        guard: payload.authenticity_flag_count == 0 && payload.unverified_metric_count == 0
        judgment:
          type: predicate
          criterion: "Does the resume text in resume_text read as written by the candidate, with concrete systems, actions, results, and methods in each bullet and no buzzwords or template phrasing?"
          min_probability: 0.75
          # Judge only the text under review; the rest of the run context skews the score.
          context_paths: [resume_text]
          include_payload: false
          fallback_adapter: script
          fallback_target: DRAFTING
      RESUME_FLAGGED:
        target: DRAFTING
        guard: payload.authenticity_flag_count > 0 || payload.unverified_metric_count > 0

  EXPORTING:
    description: "Export markdown application materials to formatted DOCX and PDF"
    prompt_template: states/exporting.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
    transitions:
      EXPORT_COMPLETE:
        target: INTERVIEW_PREP
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      EXPORT_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0

  INTERVIEW_PREP:
    description: "Generate strategic interview preparation artifact with pre-emptive overqualification defense"
    prompt_template: states/interview_prep.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - view_file
    transitions:
      PREP_GENERATED:
        target: EVOLVE_PROFILE

  EVOLVE_PROFILE:
    description: "Propose compounding newly verified skills and sharpened phrasing back to master profiles"
    prompt_template: states/evolve_profile.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - view_file
    transitions:
      EVOLUTION_COMPLETE:
        target: SUCCESS
      SKIP_EVOLUTION:
        target: SUCCESS

  SUCCESS:
    description: "Terminal success state with deliverable inventory"
    prompt_template: states/success.md

  ERROR:
    description: "Terminal failure state with diagnostic logs"
    prompt_template: states/error.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file

deliverable_projections:
  - template: templates/manifest_snapshot.md.hbs
    output: .docs/resume-manager/snapshot.md
  - template: templates/inventory.json.hbs
    output: .docs/resume-manager/inventory.json

schema_version: "2.0.0"
name: "security-scan"
version: "1.0.1"
description: "Pre-commit secret and credential scanner with remediation checklist — scans staged changes for API keys, tokens, private keys, hardcoded credentials, insecure defaults"
initial_state: "COLLECT_STAGED"

# NOTE: The middleware section below documents intended middleware hooks.
# The current runtime strips 'middleware' from the Zod schema, so these
# hooks are implemented via guards/helpers.js (guardFunction on all
# transitions) which provides audit logging, metrics export, and context
# derivation before each transition fires.

middleware:
  hooks:
    - name: telemetry
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        emitter: stdout
    - name: audit
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        destination: ".reactive/security-scan.audit.log"
        redact: ["staged_files", "scan_results", "secrets_found", "credentials_found", "findings"]
    - name: metrics
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        backend: prometheus
        port: 9091
    - name: invariant_checker
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        rules_file: "runtime/hooks/invariants.yaml"
        on_violation: halt
    - name: context_sanitizer
      trigger: pre_transition
      config:
        patterns:
          - ".*_TOKEN"
          - ".*_KEY"
          - ".*_SECRET"
          - ".*_PASSWORD"
          - "api_key"
          - "bearer"
          - "password"
          - "private_key"
          - "-----BEGIN"
        replacement: "[REDACTED]"

context_keys:
  - "staged_files"
  - "scan_results"
  - "secrets_found"
  - "credentials_found"
  - "insecure_configs"
  - "findings"
  - "remediation_steps"
  - "pass_fail_verdict"
  - "critical_findings"

default_context:
  staged_files: []
  scan_results: []
  secrets_found: []
  credentials_found: []
  insecure_configs: []
  findings: []
  remediation_steps: []
  pass_fail_verdict: null
  critical_findings: []

states:
  COLLECT_STAGED:
    description: "Collect git-staged files for scanning"
    prompt_template: "states/collect_staged.md"
    tools: ["run_command", "view_file", "grep_search"]
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "COLLECTION_STARTED"
    transitions:
      STAGED_FILES:
        target: "SCAN_PIPELINE"
        guard: "Array.isArray(event.payload.staged_files) && event.payload.staged_files.length > 0"
        guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

  SCAN_PIPELINE:
    description: "Composite state: secrets scan, credentials scan, config scan"
    initial_substate: "SECRETS_SCAN"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "SCAN_STARTED"
    transitions:
      CRITICAL_SECRET_FOUND:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.severity === 'critical'"
        guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"
    substates:
      SECRETS_SCAN:
        description: "Scan for API keys, tokens, private keys using regex + entropy heuristics"
        prompt_template: "states/scan_pipeline/secrets_scan.md"
        tools: ["run_command", "grep_search", "view_file"]
        transitions:
          SECRETS_SCANNED:
            target: "SCAN_PIPELINE.CREDENTIALS_SCAN"
            guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
            guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

      CREDENTIALS_SCAN:
        description: "Scan for hardcoded credentials (passwords, API keys in config)"
        prompt_template: "states/scan_pipeline/credentials_scan.md"
        tools: ["run_command", "grep_search", "view_file"]
        transitions:
          CREDENTIALS_SCANNED:
            target: "SCAN_PIPELINE.CONFIG_SCAN"
            guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
            guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

      CONFIG_SCAN:
        description: "Scan for insecure defaults, hardcoded IPs, debug mode in production"
        prompt_template: "states/scan_pipeline/config_scan.md"
        tools: ["run_command", "grep_search", "view_file"]
        transitions:
          CONFIG_SCANNED:
            target: "REPORT"
            guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
            guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

  REPORT:
    description: "Composite state: generate findings summary and remediation checklist"
    initial_substate: "VIOLATION_SUMMARY"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "REPORT_STARTED"
    transitions:
      REPORT_ERROR:
        target: "ERROR"
        guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"
    substates:
      VIOLATION_SUMMARY:
        description: "Summarize all findings by severity and category"
        prompt_template: "states/report/violation_summary.md"
        tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file"]
        transitions:
          SUMMARY_GENERATED:
            target: "REPORT.REMEDIATION"
            guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

      REMEDIATION:
        description: "Generate actionable remediation checklist for each finding"
        prompt_template: "states/report/remediation.md"
        tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file"]
        transitions:
          REMEDIATION_GENERATED:
            target: "GATE"
            guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

  GATE:
    description: "Human review gate: pass, request remediation, or block"
    prompt_template: "states/gate.md"
    human_gate:
      type: "choice"
      tool: "ask_question"
      options:
        - "Pass (no critical issues)"
        - "Request Remediation (re-run scan)"
        - "Block Commit (critical issues found)"
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: "COMPLETED"
        guard: "event.payload.approved === true"
        guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"
      REQUEST_REMEDIATION:
        target: "SCAN_PIPELINE"
        guard: "event.payload.remediation_requested === true"
        guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.rejected === true"
        guardFunction: "guards/helpers.js"

  COMPLETED:
    description: "Terminal state: Scan complete, no critical issues"
    prompt_template: "states/completed.md"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "DELIVERABLE_READY"

  BLOCKED:
    description: "Terminal state: Critical secrets or credentials found, commit blocked"
    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "SKILL_BLOCKED"

  ERROR:
    description: "Terminal state: Unrecoverable error occurred"
    prompt_template: "states/error.md"
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: "SKILL_ERROR"

deliverable_projections:
  - template: "templates/findings.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/security-scan/findings.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION", "SIGNAL_EMITTED"]
  - template: "templates/remediation_checklist.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/security-scan/remediation-checklist.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]
  - template: "templates/state_snapshot.json.hbs"
    output: ".docs/security-scan/state.json"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]

schema_version: 2.1.0
name: skill-manager
version: 1.4.3
description: >-
  Full CRUD lifecycle management for reactive skills - CREATE UPDATE DELETE
  MIGRATE_LEGACY and MIGRATE_REACTIVE with pre-COMMIT approval best-effort
  rollback and manifest snapshot projection
initial_state: INIT
runtime_requirements:
  min_runtime_version: "0.16.0"
  required_capabilities:
    - runtime.bootloader
    - runtime.preflight
    - runtime.transport_handshake
context_keys:
  - skill_name
  - operation
  - skill_config
  - migrate_mode
  - source_version
  - target_version
  - authoring_source
  - target_skill_dir
  - manager_skill_dir
  - revision_feedback
states:
  INIT:
    description: 'Bootloader: Verify reactive runtime environment'
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: READY
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: SETUP_RUNTIME
  SETUP_RUNTIME:
    description: Auto-configure harness MCP server
    prompt_template: states/setup_runtime.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      SETUP_COMPLETE:
        target: READY
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      SETUP_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  READY:
    prompt_template: states/ready.md
    transitions:
      USER_INVOKED:
        target: PARSING
        guard: context.skill_name != null
  PARSING:
    prompt_template: states/parsing.md
    transitions:
      PARSED:
        target: DETECTING
        guard: >-
          ["CREATE","UPDATE","DELETE","MIGRATE_LEGACY","MIGRATE_REACTIVE"].includes(context.operation)
      ERROR:
        target: ERROR
        guard: >-
          !["CREATE","UPDATE","DELETE","MIGRATE_LEGACY","MIGRATE_REACTIVE"].includes(context.operation)
  DETECTING:
    prompt_template: states/detecting.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
    transitions:
      NOT_EXISTS_CREATE:
        target: PLANNING
        guard: context.operation === "CREATE"
      EXISTS_CREATE:
        target: ERROR
        guard: context.operation === "CREATE"
      EXISTS_UPDATE_DELETE:
        target: PLANNING
        guard: '["UPDATE","DELETE"].includes(context.operation)'
      NOT_EXISTS_UPDATE_DELETE:
        target: ERROR
        guard: '["UPDATE","DELETE"].includes(context.operation)'
      IS_LEGACY:
        target: BACKING_UP_MIGRATE
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_LEGACY"
      IS_NOT_LEGACY:
        target: ERROR
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_LEGACY"
      IS_V1_REACTIVE:
        target: BACKING_UP_MIGRATE
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_REACTIVE"
      NOT_V1_REACTIVE:
        target: ERROR
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_REACTIVE"
  PLANNING:
    prompt_template: states/planning.md
    transitions:
      PLAN_READY:
        target: APPROVING
  APPROVING:
    prompt_template: states/approving.md
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: EXECUTING
      USER_REVISE:
        target: REVISING
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: CANCELLED
  REVISING:
    prompt_template: states/revising.md
    transitions:
      PLAN_READY:
        target: APPROVING
  EXECUTING:
    prompt_template: states/executing.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      EXECUTED:
        target: VERIFYING
  VERIFYING:
    prompt_template: states/verifying.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      VERIFIED_OK:
        target: PROJECTING
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      VERIFIED_FAIL:
        target: ROLLING_BACK
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  ROLLING_BACK:
    prompt_template: states/rolling_back.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      ROLLED_BACK:
        target: ERROR
      ROLLBACK_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  BACKING_UP_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/backing_up_migrate.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      BACKED_UP_LEGACY:
        target: INFERRING_LEGACY
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_LEGACY"
      BACKED_UP_REACTIVE:
        target: INSPECTING_REACTIVE
        guard: context.operation === "MIGRATE_REACTIVE"
  INFERRING_LEGACY:
    prompt_template: states/inferring_legacy.md
    transitions:
      INFERRED:
        target: PLANNING_MIGRATE
        guard: payload.confidence >= 0.5
      LOW_CONFIDENCE:
        target: GRILLING_MIGRATE
        guard: payload.confidence < 0.5
  GRILLING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/grilling_migrate.md
    transitions:
      GRILL_COMPLETE:
        target: PLANNING_MIGRATE
  INSPECTING_REACTIVE:
    prompt_template: states/inspecting_reactive.md
    transitions:
      INSPECTED:
        target: PLANNING_MIGRATE
  PLANNING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/planning_migrate.md
    transitions:
      PLAN_READY:
        target: APPROVING_MIGRATE
  APPROVING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/approving_migrate.md
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: EXECUTING_MIGRATE
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: RESTORING_MIGRATE
  EXECUTING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/executing_migrate.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      EXECUTED:
        target: VERIFYING_MIGRATE
  VERIFYING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/verifying_migrate.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - run_command
      - find_by_name
      - grep_search
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      VERIFIED_OK:
        target: PROJECTING
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      VERIFIED_FAIL:
        target: RESTORING_MIGRATE
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  RESTORING_MIGRATE:
    prompt_template: states/restoring_migrate.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
      - list_dir
    transitions:
      RESTORED:
        target: ERROR
      RESTORE_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
  PROJECTING:
    prompt_template: states/projecting.md
    transitions:
      PROJECTED:
        target: SUCCESS
  SUCCESS:
    prompt_template: states/success.md
  CANCELLED:
    prompt_template: states/cancelled.md
  ERROR:
    prompt_template: states/error.md
    tools:
      - write_to_file
deliverable_projections:
  - template: templates/manifest_snapshot.md.hbs
    output: .docs/skill-manager/{{context.skill_name}}-snapshot.md
  - template: templates/inventory.json.hbs
    output: .docs/skill-manager/inventory.json
    table: skill_inventory

schema_version: 2.1.0
name: systems-diagnosis
version: 1.0.1
description: >-
  Diagnose recurring or surprising behavior in a system, explain it through
  observed patterns and structure, and develop a testable intervention.
initial_state: INIT

context_keys:
  - problem_statement
  - behavior_over_time
  - system_boundary
  - time_horizon
  - desired_outcome
  - key_actors
  - system_map
  - causal_hypotheses
  - archetype_hypotheses
  - candidate_interventions
  - selected_intervention
  - test_plan
  - final_diagnosis

default_context:
  problem_statement: null
  behavior_over_time: null
  system_boundary: null
  time_horizon: null
  desired_outcome: null
  key_actors: []
  system_map: null
  causal_hypotheses: []
  archetype_hypotheses: []
  candidate_interventions: []
  selected_intervention: null
  test_plan: null
  final_diagnosis: null

states:
  INIT:
    description: Verify access to the reactive runtime.
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: INTAKE
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: BYPASS_DETECTED

  INTAKE:
    description: Capture the recurring behavior, evidence, and decision need.
    prompt_template: states/intake.md
    transitions:
      INTAKE_READY:
        target: DEFINE_BOUNDARY
        guard: context.problem_statement != null && context.behavior_over_time != null
      NEED_INTAKE_DETAIL:
        target: INTAKE

  DEFINE_BOUNDARY:
    description: Confirm the system boundary, time horizon, actors, and desired outcome.
    prompt_template: states/define_boundary.md
    transitions:
      BOUNDARY_CONFIRMED:
        target: MAP_STRUCTURE
        guard: context.system_boundary != null && context.time_horizon != null && context.desired_outcome != null
      SCOPE_REVISED:
        target: DEFINE_BOUNDARY

  MAP_STRUCTURE:
    description: Map relevant elements, stocks, flows, information, feedback, delays, and rules.
    prompt_template: states/map_structure.md
    transitions:
      MAP_READY:
        target: DIAGNOSE_DYNAMICS
        guard: context.system_map != null
      MAP_NEEDS_EVIDENCE:
        target: MAP_STRUCTURE
      TARGET_CHANGED:
        target: INTAKE

  DIAGNOSE_DYNAMICS:
    description: Explain the observed pattern with testable causal hypotheses.
    prompt_template: states/diagnose_dynamics.md
    transitions:
      DYNAMICS_EXPLAINED:
        target: SELECT_LEVERAGE
        guard: Array.isArray(context.causal_hypotheses) && context.causal_hypotheses.length > 0
      EVIDENCE_CONFLICTS:
        target: MAP_STRUCTURE

  SELECT_LEVERAGE:
    description: Compare feasible, context-specific intervention points.
    prompt_template: states/select_leverage.md
    transitions:
      LEVERAGE_SELECTED:
        target: DESIGN_TEST
        guard: context.selected_intervention != null
      NO_VIABLE_OPTION:
        target: DIAGNOSE_DYNAMICS

  DESIGN_TEST:
    description: Design a bounded test with measures, timing, and stop conditions.
    prompt_template: states/design_test.md
    transitions:
      TEST_DESIGNED:
        target: SYNTHESIZE
        guard: context.test_plan != null
      TEST_UNSAFE:
        target: SELECT_LEVERAGE

  SYNTHESIZE:
    description: Present the diagnosis, uncertainty, intervention, and test plan.
    prompt_template: states/synthesize.md

  BYPASS_DETECTED:
    description: Stop when runtime setup fails or the signal contract is bypassed.
    prompt_template: states/bypass_detected.md

schema_version: "2.1.0"
name: tdd-refactor
version: "2.0.6"
description: >-
  Hierarchical TDD & Refactoring state machine with nested micro-cycles,
  regression detection, event bubbling, and live projections
initial_state: INIT
strict_execution: true
context_keys:
  - requirement
  - target_file
  - test_file
  - refactor_cycles
  - clean_passes
default_context:
  requirement: null
  target_file: src/auth.ts
  test_file: tests/auth.test.ts
  refactor_cycles: 0
  clean_passes: 0
states:
  INIT:
    description: 'Bootloader: Verify reactive runtime environment'
    prompt_template: states/init.md
    transitions:
      RUNTIME_READY:
        target: RED_SPEC
      SETUP_REQUIRED:
        target: SETUP_RUNTIME
  SETUP_RUNTIME:
    description: Auto-configure harness MCP server
    prompt_template: states/setup_runtime.md
    tools:
      - run_command
    transitions:
      SETUP_COMPLETE:
        target: RED_SPEC
        guard: payload.exit_code == 0
      SETUP_FAILED:
        target: ERROR
        guard: payload.exit_code != 0
  RED_SPEC:
    description: Author a strictly failing test specifying the new requirement
    prompt_template: states/red_spec.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - run_command
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: ENTERED_RED_PHASE
    transitions:
      TEST_RAN:
        target: GREEN_CODE
        guard: event.payload.exit_code != 0
  GREEN_CODE:
    description: Write minimal implementation code to turn the test suite green
    prompt_template: states/green_code.md
    tools:
      - view_file
      - write_to_file
      - replace_file_content
      - run_command
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: ENTERED_GREEN_PHASE
    transitions:
      TEST_RAN:
        target: REFACTOR
        guard: event.payload.exit_code === 0
  REFACTOR:
    description: 'Composite state: Clean Code, Optimize Architecture, and Verify Invariants'
    initial_substate: CLEAN_CODE
    on_enter:
      - set_context:
          refactor_cycles: 1
      - emit_signal: REFACTOR_CYCLE_STARTED
    on_exit:
      - emit_signal: REFACTOR_CYCLE_CONCLUDED
    transitions:
      GLOBAL_ABORT:
        target: RED_SPEC
      TEST_RAN:
        target: GREEN_CODE
        guard: event.payload.exit_code != 0
    substates:
      CLEAN_CODE:
        description: Simplify naming, remove duplication, and extract deep helpers
        prompt_template: states/clean_code.md
        tools:
          - view_file
          - write_to_file
          - replace_file_content
          - run_command
        transitions:
          CLEANING_DONE:
            target: REFACTOR.PERF_AUDIT
      PERF_AUDIT:
        description: >-
          Analyze complexity, eliminate unnecessary allocations and redundant
          I/O
        prompt_template: states/perf_audit.md
        tools:
          - view_file
          - write_to_file
          - replace_file_content
          - run_command
        transitions:
          AUDIT_PASSED:
            target: AUDIT_VERIFY
  AUDIT_VERIFY:
    description: Run full verification suite, linter, and type checks
    prompt_template: states/audit_verify.md
    tools:
      - run_command
      - view_file
    transitions:
      ALL_CHECKS_PASSED:
        target: COMPLETED
        guard: event.payload.exit_code === 0
      REGRESSION_DETECTED:
        target: GREEN_CODE
  COMPLETED:
    description: TDD Refactor cycle finished successfully
    prompt_template: states/completed.md
    on_enter:
      - emit_signal: DELIVERABLE_READY
  ERROR:
    description: Runtime setup failed
  BYPASS_DETECTED:
    description: "Terminal State: Bypass detected - Agent operated outside signal contract"
deliverable_projections:
  - template: templates/refactor_summary.md.hbs
    output: .docs/tdd-refactor-summary.md
  - template: templates/state_snapshot.json.hbs
    output: .docs/state-snapshot.json

schema_version: "2.0.0"
name: "test-coverage-gate"
version: "1.0.1"
description: "Test coverage quality gate that establishes a clean baseline, measures statement, branch, function, and line coverage, analyzes gaps, and blocks release below explicit thresholds."
initial_state: "INTAKE"

middleware:
  hooks:
    - name: telemetry
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        emitter: stdout
    - name: audit
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        destination: ".reactive/test-coverage-gate.audit.log"
        redact: []
    - name: invariant_checker
      trigger: post_transition
      config:
        rules_file: "runtime/hooks/invariants.yaml"
        on_violation: halt
    - name: context_sanitizer
      trigger: pre_transition
      config:
        patterns:
          - ".*_TOKEN"
          - ".*_KEY"
          - ".*_SECRET"
          - "password"
          - "api_key"
        replacement: "[REDACTED]"

context_keys:
  - "target_dir"
  - "test_command"
  - "coverage_command"
  - "thresholds"
  - "baseline_exit_code"
  - "coverage_report"
  - "coverage_metrics"
  - "coverage_gaps"
  - "gate_decision"
  - "deliverable_path"

default_context:
  target_dir: "."
  test_command: null
  coverage_command: null
  thresholds: null
  baseline_exit_code: null
  coverage_report: null
  coverage_metrics: null
  coverage_gaps: []
  gate_decision: null
  deliverable_path: null

states:
  INTAKE:
    description: "Collect target, test command, coverage command, and quality thresholds"
    prompt_template: "states/intake.md"
    tools: ["view_file", "run_command"]
    transitions:
      INTAKE_READY:
        target: "CONFIGURE"
        guard: "event.payload.target_dir != null && event.payload.test_command != null && event.payload.coverage_command != null && event.payload.thresholds != null"
      INTAKE_INVALID:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.target_dir == null || event.payload.test_command == null || event.payload.coverage_command == null || event.payload.thresholds == null"

  CONFIGURE:
    description: "Validate commands, threshold schema, and coverage report format"
    prompt_template: "states/configure.md"
    tools: ["run_command", "view_file"]
    transitions:
      CONFIGURATION_READY:
        target: "BASELINE"
        guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0 && event.payload.thresholds != null"
      CONFIGURATION_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.exit_code !== 0 || event.payload.thresholds == null"

  BASELINE:
    description: "Run the unmodified test suite and require a clean baseline"
    prompt_template: "states/baseline.md"
    tools: ["run_command"]
    transitions:
      BASELINE_PASSED:
        target: "MEASURE"
        guard: "event.payload.exit_code === 0"
      BASELINE_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.exit_code !== 0"

  MEASURE:
    description: "Run coverage collection and parse the machine-readable report"
    prompt_template: "states/measure.md"
    tools: ["run_command", "view_file"]
    transitions:
      COVERAGE_MEASURED:
        target: "ANALYZE"
        guard: "event.payload.coverage_report != null && event.payload.coverage_metrics != null"
      MEASUREMENT_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.coverage_report == null || event.payload.coverage_metrics == null"

  ANALYZE:
    description: "Compare coverage metrics with thresholds and identify actionable gaps"
    prompt_template: "states/analyze.md"
    tools: ["view_file", "write_to_file", "grep_search"]
    transitions:
      GAPS_ANALYZED:
        target: "GATE"
        guard: "event.payload.coverage_metrics != null && Array.isArray(event.payload.coverage_gaps)"
      ANALYSIS_FAILED:
        target: "ERROR"
        guard: "event.payload.coverage_metrics == null || !Array.isArray(event.payload.coverage_gaps)"

  GATE:
    description: "Human quality gate for threshold exceptions and release blocking"
    prompt_template: "states/gate.md"
    tools: ["view_file"]
    human_gate:
      type: "choice"
      tool: "ask_question"
      options:
        - "Accept coverage result"
        - "Request gap remediation"
        - "Block release"
    transitions:
      USER_APPROVED:
        target: "SUCCESS"
        guard: "event.payload.approved === true"
      USER_REQUEST_REMEDIATION:
        target: "MEASURE"
        guard: "event.payload.remediation_requested === true"
      USER_REJECTED:
        target: "BLOCKED"
        guard: "event.payload.rejected === true"

  SUCCESS:
    description: "Terminal state: coverage gate passed"
    prompt_template: "states/success.md"

  BLOCKED:
    description: "Terminal state: coverage gate blocked release"
    prompt_template: "states/blocked.md"

  ERROR:
    description: "Terminal state: coverage workflow failed"
    prompt_template: "states/error.md"

deliverable_projections:
  - template: "templates/coverage_report.md.hbs"
    output: ".docs/test-coverage-gate/coverage-report.md"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]
  - template: "templates/state_snapshot.json.hbs"
    output: ".docs/test-coverage-gate/state.json"
    trigger_on: ["STATE_TRANSITION"]
